£41,000 - £45,000
End Date
11 December 2026
Notes
We are seeking a reliable, organised and proactive Housekeeper / Family Assistant with Homework Tutoring responsibilities to join a private family household in Douglas, Isle of Man. This is a long-term, live-out position supporting a family with two school-aged children, aged 11 and 13.

The role combines general housekeeping, cooking and household organisation with after-school supervision, homework assistance and educational support. Responsibilities include cleaning and tidying the home, laundry, ironing, changing bed linen, organising clothing and school uniforms, preparing and serving lunch, preparing evening meals and ensuring the household runs smoothly.

The successful candidate will also support the children when they return from school at approximately 5:15 pm. This will include supervising homework, providing tutoring in agreed subjects where appropriate, encouraging good study habits and helping prepare school bags, uniforms and other essentials for the following day. During school holidays, responsibilities may be adjusted to include additional childcare and family support.

Previous experience in housekeeping, nanny-housekeeping, family support or a similar role is desirable. Candidates should be confident preparing meals, managing household tasks independently and working with school-aged children. Previous teaching or tutoring experience would be a strong advantage. We are looking for someone trustworthy, patient, dependable and proactive, with good communication and organisational skills. Applicants must also be comfortable around a small dog and cat.

The proposed working hours are Monday to Friday, 12:00 noon to 7:00 pm, with 35 guaranteed paid hours per week, including a 30-minute paid break each day. The salary is £41,000–£45,000 gross per annum, depending on experience and agreed responsibilities. Alternative working arrangements may be considered for the right candidate.

To apply, please email your CV or a brief summary of your relevant experience, qualifications and availability to fairhaven8a@gmail.com. Please include details of any previous housekeeping, childcare, teaching or tutoring experience.

As a Civils Setting Out Engineer, you will play an important role in ensuring our works are constructed accurately, safely and in accordance with the relevant drawings, specifications and programme.

Setting out civil engineering, groundworks and infrastructure projects.

We’re looking for someone who is eager to learn, willing to get stuck in and interested in developing their skills within the drainage industry. Previous drainage experience is an advantage, but we’re happy to train the right person who has a positive attitude and a strong work ethic.

Key Responsibilities

Carry out drainage repairs, maintenance and inspections.

Respond to emergency drainage call-outs.

Use specialist equipment and tools to diagnose and resolve drainage issues.

Assist with blockages and other drainage-related work.

Provide a professional service to customers.

Requirements:

Full driving licence.

A strong work ethic and willingness to learn.

Punctual and able to work well as part of a team.

Good practical and problem-solving skills.

Willingness to participate in an on-call rota and respond to emergency call-outs.

Previous experience in drainage, construction or a similar trade is beneficial but not essential.

What We Offer

Full training for the right candidate.

The opportunity to develop practical skills and build a career in the drainage industry.

A varied role with opportunities to learn and progress.

If you’re hardworking and ready to learn, we’d love to hear from you.

To apply, please get in touch with Drainage Consultants Ltd at info@drainageconsultants.im or 01624 612 612.

Our client is seeking a qualified lawyer to join the busy commercial litigation team of an established Isle of Man firm. The role involves providing accurate, comprehensive technical and strategic legal advice to clients, managing your own files and caseload with responsibility appropriate to your level of experience, and supporting senior advocates in progressing theirs. You will also undertake legal research and prepare clear briefing notes, attend client meetings and calls and circulate notes afterwards, draft court papers and applications, and assist with disclosure and document-management projects. The work spans complex commercial cases, shareholder and directors’ duties disputes, trust disputes, civil fraud and asset tracing, insolvency and liquidations, banking disputes, and financial services and regulatory matters. Applications are welcomed from both junior and senior advocates. Our client will also consider lawyers qualified in other Commonwealth jurisdictions who are interested in relocating to the Isle of Man and requalifying locally. This is an excellent opportunity to build broad contentious experience within a well-regarded practice. Our client, an Isle of Man fiduciary business, is seeking an experienced Head of Compliance on a six-month contract. You will report to the board on compliance matters, prepare and submit regulatory returns, act as a point of contact for the regulator, and oversee customer due diligence, business and customer risk assessments, and periodic file reviews. You will also advise the wider business on regulatory and financial crime matters, deliver compliance training, and support any remediation or project work required during the contract term. Significant compliance experience within a trust and corporate service provider is essential, along with a thorough working knowledge of Isle of Man regulatory requirements and the confidence to operate at board level from day one. A relevant professional qualification such as ICA Dip is also essential. This is a contract position and would suit an experienced compliance professional available at short notice. Ready for your next step in leadership?

We have an exciting opportunity to join the Isle of Man-based team as an Assistant Branch Manager (ABM). This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who is passionate about people, customers and making things happen.

You’ll be at the heart of our Banking Hall, leading from the floor, supporting colleagues to be at their best and helping us deliver brilliant customer experiences while maintaining strong operational standards.

Working closely with the Branch Manager, you’ll have real ownership of the day-to-day running of the Banking Hall and Cash & Counter operation.

This is more than an operational role. It is an opportunity to lead, influence and make a real difference to our colleagues, our customers and the success of the branch.

Passion for developing people, creating outstanding customer experiences, and helping build a Banking Hall where everyone can perform at their best is essential.

Lead the Banking Hall, spending around 70% of your time on the floor supporting colleagues and customers, and ensuring the team is clear on daily priorities

Maintain strong operational controls, responsible for cash limits, ATM routines and operational standards, and acting as the first point of escalation for ATM, IDM and TCR issues.
Manage Back to Your Best plans and drive continuous improvement in how the team works and serves customers.

We're looking for Customer Service Superheroes!

Feel Connected to the future at Sure by joining the Customer Experience team as a Customer Service Advisor in the the Isle of Man working 37 hours per week.

Are you looking for a career where every day is different? Where you can use your excellent communication skills to solve mysteries, answer queries and put a smile on someone's face?

Sure are looking for candidates who would like to feel connected to future technologies and change, global opportunities, personal development, and working in a great team. Passionate about their people and communities, the ideal individual would hold the following skills:

A passion for putting the customer first and achieving customer focused outcomes whilst having high levels of empathy.
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to translate the complex into more easily understood terms.
Well organised and methodical, driven to produce accurate and quality work.
Self-motivated and driven to take responsibility for customer issues, seeing them through to completion. 
To drive the role forward, the individual will provide an efficient and professional service to customers over the phone or online, supporting customer queries, faults, and requests for service. You will strive for customer excellence and ensure all customers are dealt with efficiently and in a welcoming and friendly way.

Applicants should note that the role will include working evening, weekends, and bank holidays on a rota basis. The Customer contact centre operates from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Monday to Friday and 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Saturdays also some public holiday cover will be required.  Therefore, applicants should note that they will be required to work shifts within these times, and that these times will be subject to change.

We are proud of the “way we do things” at Sure; We work together as One Team, We strive for Customer Satisfaction, We are Reliable, We have a Passion for Technology & Learning and We are Community & Sustainability Focused, and individuals applying will “feel connected” to our Company values.

You will be joining a Company that is committed to developing highly engaged professional employees, offering a competitive remuneration package with total earnings from £27,000 - higher depending on skills and experience, as well as great staff benefits:

Free Ultrafast Broadband,
Free Unlimited Max mobile contract,
Generous bonus scheme,
Healthcare
Company pension
Parking/Bicycle facilities 
To apply, please send CVs to recruitment@sure.com or visit careers.sure.com for further information.

We're Hiring!
Front of House Team Member.
South of the Island - Please note that you must have your own transport for our remote location.

vacancies@bdc.im

Are you a friendly, energetic people-person who loves great coffee, good food and even better company? Our cafe in the south of the island is on the lookout for a warm, reliable Front of House team member to join our small, close-knit crew. If you take pride in looking after guests and keeping a busy cafe running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
The Role
Position: Front of House (FOH).
Hours: 25-40 hours per week (across weekdays and weekends).
Pay: Minimum wage.
Location: South of the island.
Own transport: Essential.
What You'll Be Doing
As part of our Front of House team, your day-to-day will include:
Opening and closing of the cafe.
Greet, assist and seat guests.
Take customer orders efficiently and accurately and communicate orders to Back of House (BOH).
Provide a good level of customer service (including preparation of beverages and food).
Maintaining order within the cafe and adhere to required standards.
Setting of tables and assisting BOH with delivery of meals.
Co-ordination between FOH and BOH to maintain timely service.
Clearing of tables during service and cleaning of tables and surrounds post service.
Ensuring the outside deck, cafe, bar area and bathrooms are kept clean and maintained at appropriate hygiene standards and a professional image is always portrayed.
Ordering of beverage and snack stock from suppliers.
Inventory management – replenishment of beverages, snacks and condiments, including stock rotation.
Filing of delivery notes and invoices.
Monthly stocktaking of all FOH items.
Accurate recording of transactions and end of day cash-up and safe keeping of monies.
Replying to emails and telephonic bookings if required.
Receiving and accumulating general customer feedback.
Preparation of staff rosters and work scheduling.
Always maintain a professional appearance.
Performing any reasonable ad-hoc tasks requested by the Manager / Owners.
About You
Previous hospitality or cafe experience preferred.
Own reliable transport is essential.
Warm, friendly and customer-focused.
Reliable, punctual and well-presented.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and as part of a team.
Good communication skills and a positive attitude.
Able to work flexible shifts, including weekends.
What We Offer
A warm, supportive team and a relaxed island work environment.
Stable hours (30-40 per week) with a regular roster.
The chance to grow your hospitality skills in a busy, well-loved cafe.
How to Apply
If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you. Please email your CV and a short note about yourself to vacancies@bdc.im 

We can't wait to welcome the right person to the team!

We’re looking for passionate Early Years Educators to join our bank team at Victoria House Nursery in Douglas.

Our ambition is to give every child an exceptional beginning: the security to feel they belong, the confidence to express themselves and the curiosity to explore their world. We bring that ambition to life through thoughtful environments, rich learning experiences and educators who recognise the individuality and potential of every child.

As a bank educator, you’ll help cover staff holidays, sickness and busier periods. You’ll become a valued part of our team, building relationships, encouraging discovery and bringing warmth, creativity and care to each day you spend with us.

Shifts are offered as needed, with no obligation to accept. You choose the opportunities that fit around your family, studies or other commitments.

As an AI Project Engineer, you’ll work with our engineering and production teams to design, build and test robotics, automation and AI systems for industrial use. You’ll agree what each system needs to do, build prototypes that bring together sensors, electronics, embedded controllers and software, and develop machine vision or monitoring tools where they solve a practical problem. You’ll test prototypes in realistic operating conditions, diagnose faults and document your designs and results so colleagues can use and maintain the systems. You’ll need a relevant engineering or computing qualification, or equivalent practical experience, plus hands-on experience combining hardware and software in robotics, automation or embedded systems. You should be comfortable writing and debugging Python and embedded C or C++, working with sensors and microcontrollers, and developing or testing a machine learning or computer vision model. Experience from employment, placements or academic projects is welcome.
To apply, please email your CV and a short note about a relevant project you’ve worked on to hr@hensonceramics.com, using ‘AI Project Engineer’ as the subject line.

Notes
We are looking to appoint a new member of staff; some experience would be helpful.
We run a mixed farm with 350 sheep, 10+ pigs, free ranging chickens, a donkey and 2 ponies. Alongside this we have diversified into tourism, therefore, we are looking to appoint someone who is happy to have a DBS check and work with members of the public. The appointed person should be used to working outdoors, ideally with experience of livestock management, especially sheep. They need to be capable of working both independently as well as part of a team. Alongside this, they should have a full driving licence.
Work entails primarily farm work, however, there will also be a responsibility to maintain a level of excellence throughout the business for our guests (cutting the grass, keeping the grounds tidy etc).
We would like someone who is sympathetic to working in a Christian community.
Hours would be 12 per week, Monday, Wednesday, and Friday mornings, 9am-1pm. On top of this there will be occasional holiday cover at weekends. The position starts from January 2027.
Pay depends on experience and there are potential extra hours during lambing time.Key responsibilities:
Helping to manage the sheep flock, feeding, lambing, worming, weighing and shearing. General farm work and maintenance, feeding & giving water to the animals, fencing and dry-stone walling.
Holiday cover of the farm when the Andersons go away, wood cutting, delivery and chopping, cleaning out pigs, ponies, chickens, dogs, sheep, looking after ponies, pony rides at Lambing Live.
Estate managing, grass, trees, outside of all buildings, bin collection. Helping with Educational trip and AES applications.
For more details and to apply please email info@knockaloebegfarm.com with your CV and a cover letter detailing your experience.

Our client seeks an experienced and well organised Finance Assistant to join their team for a 6 month contract. Key Responsibilities: Process payments (electronic payments, telegraphic transfer). Monthly bank reconciliations. Maintain and monitor bank accounts and update cashbook spreadsheets. Monitor inward bank statements and reconcile against cashbook spreadsheets. Produce weekly cash balance and treasury reports in line with client requirements. Process and allocate receipts (cheques, cash and telegraphic transfers). Coding and posting of entries into SUN. Code, process, monitor and maintain purchase invoices / purchase ledger from receipt of invoices to payment in agreed settlement terms. Schedule, raise, code, monitor and maintain sales invoices / sales ledger and recharges processes from production of the invoices to receipt in agreed settlement terms. Key Skills and Experience: Experience of banking systems (essential). Numerate and show attention to detail and accuracy. Well organised and have the ability to prioritise tasks. Able to work well under pressure and achieve targets set. Experience of Excel and Word. Self-motivated and enthusiastic about working in a busy team. Good communication skills as the role involves contact with other departments, external directors and banks. Some knowledge of book-keeping. Experience of SUN general ledger system (desirable but not essential).

Notes
Role Purpose
The Senior Administrator is responsible for delivering an accurate, efficient and customer-focused investment administration service. The role involves managing transactions and complex queries, maintaining strong operational controls, supporting colleagues and contributing to continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities
Investment Administration

Process investment transactions and customer requests accurately and within agreed service levels.

Maintain accurate investment, asset and customer records.

Liaise with fund managers, custodians, advisers and other counterparties to resolve queries and progress transactions.

Investigate complex issues, resolve outstanding transactions and escalate where necessary.

Follow established procedures, controls and regulatory requirements.

Customer and Stakeholder Management

Deliver a professional, timely and customer-focused service.

Take ownership of queries through to resolution.

Communicate clearly and work collaboratively with internal teams and external stakeholders.

Risk, Controls and Quality

Maintain high standards of accuracy and identify operational risks, errors and control weaknesses.

Complete quality checks and authorised activities where required.

Support investigations, corrective actions and accurate management reporting.

Team Support and Development

Provide technical guidance and support to colleagues.

Share knowledge, assist with training and contribute to workload planning.

Support the Team Leader or Manager with daily operations and wider team activities.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls and customer outcomes.

Support system changes, testing, procedure updates and business improvement initiatives.

Person Specification
Experience and Knowledge

Experience in financial services, ideally in investments, investment operations, life assurance or administration.

Good understanding of investment administration and operational processes.

Knowledge of funds, equities and bonds is desirable.

Experience handling complex queries, liaising with external parties and supporting colleagues is advantageous.

Skills and Behavior's

Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Excellent organisation, prioritisation and problem-solving skills.

Clear written and verbal communication.

Ability to manage competing priorities and work under pressure.

Customer-focused, proactive and accountable approach.

Collaborative attitude with a willingness to support and develop colleagues.

Adaptability and commitment to continuous learning.

Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook and Word.

For more details and to apply contact epl.admin@epl.im

We are recruiting for a Group Assistant Tax Business Partner to join our client's tax team, supporting the completion of tax compliance work and the development of junior team members. The role involves managing a portfolio of trust and company clients to ensure all tax compliance and reporting obligations are completed accurately and within statutory filing deadlines. You will prepare and review group tax reporting requirements including Income Tax, Corporation Tax, Capital Gains Tax, ATED, Inheritance Tax returns, RISPG calculations and VAT, with potential to develop expertise in other areas and jurisdictions. You will review work completed by trainee and junior colleagues, providing technical guidance, coaching and constructive feedback, and assist in overseeing workflow allocation and task prioritisation within the tax team. You will also review trust and company accounts from a tax perspective to identify tax risks, monitor compliance deadlines, act as a point of reference for tax queries across the organisation, liaise with clients and professional advisers on tax matters, and support fee quotation, budgeting and billing processes. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 3 years' relevant tax experience, strong technical knowledge of UK taxation, and excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, and communication abilities. ATT, STEP or ACCA qualification is preferred, with CTA studies commenced or willingness to pursue further qualifications being desirable. Experience working with fiduciary structures, trusts and companies is preferred. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career in a busy corporate services environment. Register your interest by emailing jobs@bespoke.co.im or via our website www.bespoke.co.im/contact

Our client seeks a Revenue Controller to join their team. Key Responsibilities: Manage weekly and monthly revenue postings for all companies with production and distribution of weekly revenue reporting packs. Perform weekly and monthly balance sheet reconciliations (deferred revenue, debtors, and settlement accounts). Maintain control over credit accounts along with timely distribution of statements. Conduct period-end processes, including currency revaluation, discount postings and validation of invoices. Assist with external audits by providing supporting documentation, analysis, and explanations as required. Prepare and submit quarterly ABTOT returns and support the collation of information for annual renewals. Deliver weekly analysis and ad-hoc reporting from internal systems. Produce and distribute monthly statistical reports to internal stakeholders and third parties. Conduct revenue and credit card analysis to support business performance monitoring and decision-making. Assist in the preparation of monthly financial and operational commentary. Conduct audits to ensure compliance with contractual requirements. Maintain robust financial controls across revenue recognition, reporting, and reconciliation processes. Liaise with credit card merchants and coordinate annual compliance renewals. Key Skills and Experience: GCSE Mathematics and English (or equivalent) required. A-Level qualifications or equivalent further education would be advantageous. Relevant accounting qualification or part-qualified status (e.g. ACA, ACCA, or CIMA). Proven experience within accounting, finance, or revenue control functions. Experience with data analysis and reporting tools such as Crystal Reports, MS Query, SQL Server Management Studio, or similar systems. Strong IT skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and internet-based applications. Experience or appetite for developing SQL skills would be helpful. Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads and work independently. Willingness to learn new skills and contribute additional value to the role.

About Ramsey Crookall

Established in 1946, Ramsey Crookall is the island’s most experienced and trusted firm of stockbrokers and investment managers. We’re a business that has built a reputation for professionalism, integrity, and exceptional client service. We continue to evolve, combining traditional values with modern technology to meet the needs and expectations of our clients.

About the Role

We are seeking an organised, motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our Settlements & Asset Servicing team to coordinate and administer transfers of client investments and cash into and out of the firm, ensuring instructions are handled accurately, efficiently and in accordance with internal procedures and applicable requirements.

The role involves regular liaison with clients, advisers, custodians, registrars, fund administrators and other financial institutions. Transfer cases can involve several parties and require persistent follow-up, careful record-keeping and practical problem-solving.

Direct asset transfer experience is not essential. We welcome applicants with strong administrative skills and a willingness to develop specialist knowledge. Training and ongoing support will be provided.

Key Responsibilities include: 
Coordinate incoming and outgoing transfers of client assets, including re-registrations, stock and cash movements.
Check client instructions, account information, documentation and asset details before progressing transfers.
Liaise with counterparties, custodians, registrars and fund managers to progress cases and resolve outstanding requirements.
Monitor transfer progress, reconcile movements and ensure completed transfers are recorded accurately.
Respond professionally to enquiries from clients, advisers, colleagues and external parties.
Provide timely updates on outstanding, complex or delayed transfers.
Follow up proactively and escalate issues where appropriate.
Follow internal procedures, regulatory requirements and relevant risk controls.
Maintain complete and accurate records and audit trails.
Identify discrepancies, investigate issues and refer material concerns to the Head of Settlements & Asset Servicing.
Use internal and external systems to process, monitor and track transfers.
Assist with reporting on transfer volumes, outstanding cases and turnaround times.
Suggest practical improvements to processes and support workflow enhancements.

For full job description, please visit: https://www.ramseycrookall.com/careers/administrator 

Please send your CV and a short supporting statement to hr@ramseycrookall.comby Friday 4th December 2026.

Our client seeks an experienced and talented Actuarial Model Developer (Prophet) to join their team. You will be joining a team of highly skilled actuaries and play a key role in shaping the models that support reporting, risk management, and business planning activities. The ideal candidate will be someone who combines strong technical capability with excellent problem-solving and communication skills and has proven experience in Prophet Model Development. Key Responsibilities: Develop, maintain, and enhance Prophet models supporting a range of activities, including IFRS 17 reporting, risk-based capital reporting, and business planning. Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand evolving requirements and translate them into effective modelling solutions. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through process enhancements, automation, and innovative ways of working. Ensure models and associated processes comply with company governance standards and regulatory requirements, supported by clear and robust documentation. Perform testing and validation activities to demonstrate the ongoing accuracy, reliability, and suitability of actuarial models. Support internal and external audit activities by evidencing the strength of modelling controls and governance processes. Contribute to cross-functional projects and business initiatives, providing actuarial expertise and technical insight where required. Key Skills and Experience: Full or part qualification as an Actuary. Experience in Prophet model development, Prophet Professional and Prophet Enterprise is essential. A strong degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, or a related discipline. Advanced technical skills in MS Excel and MS Access/SQL. Experience within the life insurance industry, with knowledge of a range of products, particularly unit-linked business. Understanding of IFRS 17 and risk-based capital reporting requirements. Strong analytical and numerical skills, with excellent attention to detail. The ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and effectively to a broad range of stakeholders. A proactive mindset, with the confidence to challenge existing approaches and drive continuous improvement. If you're passionate about actuarial modelling, enjoy solving complex problems, and thrive in a collaborative environment where continuous improvement is encouraged, we'd love to hear from you. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16973

Notes
We are a small to medium sized accounts practice which due to continuing growth and future plans, is now recruiting for the following role in our Port Erin office.  In return for a competitive salary and benefits package, we can offer you exciting career prospects and the opportunity to develop in a professional environment as a Senior Accountant reporting directly to the company’s Accounts Manager.  We are a friendly team and provide flexibility and support to our staff to ensure we deliver the best results to our clients. 

The successful candidate for this role should ideally have some audit experience or will be looking to develop that skillset in order to manage a small but growing portfolio of Isle of Man audit clients. 
 
Diligence, and strong organisational skills are a necessity and you must have a minimum of 3 years’ post qualification experience at a relatively senior level, preferably in an Isle of Man and/or UK accounts practice.  You must be confident and have strong, personal skills to manage a diverse range of clients across different sectors.  The workload will be varied including accounts, personal and company tax, audit, VAT, payroll and compliance services provided to a wide breadth of clients predominantly based in the Isle of Man but also in the UK and overseas.  

The successful candidate must be able to demonstrate their ability to prepare and file statutory accounts, sole trader and partnership accounts, personal and corporate tax returns including computations and schedules, and assist with reviews of work undertaken by other members of the team;  Plan and prepare for audits, including meeting with audit clients, preparing working papers, resolving queries, and executing audits in compliance with relevant auditing and accounting standards, and Isle of Man legislation.  Audits will involve a mix of on-site and office based tasks dependent on the nature of the client and the work to be undertaken.  There will be scope to develop existing and new relationships with clients, including audit clients, which will provide further opportunity to participate in the success of K5.

Applicants must have strong analytical skills, excellent communication skills and be converse with the latest accounts and audit software, as well as being proficient in Excel and other applications.  We are a busy office and being able to organise workloads and having good time management skills is essential to be able to prioritise work and meet deadlines.  Being able to work as part of a team and help train and mentor other staff is an important attribute but the right candidate must also be able to work independently and to use their own initiative to solve problems and complete tasks.  

The role is based on a full time hours (37.5hrs p.w.), although fexiblilty could be offerd depending on experience of applicant.

To apply, please forward your Curriculum Vitae (CV) together with a covering email to - Enquiries@K5ltd.im.

Comis Hotel & Golf Resort – Santon, Isle of Man
Department: Finance
Hours: 30 hours per week, generally Monday to Friday
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

We are looking for an experienced and detail-focused Accounts Assistant to join our Finance team.
Reporting to the Financial Controller, you will support the day-to-day financial operations of the business, including bank reconciliations, purchase ledger, supplier payments and maintaining accurate accounting records.

Key Responsibilities:

Daily bank and system reconciliations.
Processing supplier invoices and reconciling supplier accounts.
Preparing weekly and monthly payment batches.
Investigating cash and card variances.
Maintaining control accounts and finance spreadsheets.
Preparing journals and posting accounting entries.
Ensuring financial controls and procedures are followed.

About You:

Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, bookkeeping or similar finance role.
Strong bookkeeping and reconciliation experience.
Sound knowledge of accounting principles and VAT.
Excellent numerical skills and attention to detail.
Good Microsoft Excel skills.
Experience using accounting software; Sage Intacct would be advantageous.
Able to work independently and as part of a small team.

What We Offer:

Competitive salary.
30-hour working week, generally Monday to Friday.
Hotel discounts.
Staff meals and uniform.
Service charge participation.
Free on-site parking.
Training and development opportunities.

To apply, please send your CV to HR@comishotel.com.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the Isle of Man or UK. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Strictly no agencies.

Notes
Our client seeks a Head of Compliance to join their team on a part-time basis. Subject to regulatory approval, and after adequate training and familiarisation, the role holder will ultimately hold the following statutory positions: Compliance Officer, under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book. Ideally, Money Laundering Reporting Officer, under the IOM AML/CFT Code 2019. You must be able to satisfy the IOM FSA on competence, time commitment, accessibility and effective oversight. An initial familiarisation period may be agreed before specific statutory positions are formally transferred. Key Responsibilities: Discharge the statutory role under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book, acting as primary point of contact with the IOM FSA. Maintain compliance monitoring programme, regulatory returns, statutory registers, policy suite and the authorisation of new SPV structures. Oversee periodic client reviews and approve higher-risk new business across the SPV book. Ideally hold the MLRO function, receive internal reports, liaise with the IOM Financial Intelligence Unit. Run group sanctions screening (OFSI, OFAC, EU, UN), customer due diligence and transaction monitoring proportionate to the group's exposure, with particular attention to maritime risk. Deliver annual AML/CFT training to employees and report to the relevant boards on financial crime risk. Maintain the compliance requirements and risk assessment suite, AML/CFT and policy suite, and report to the Board. Key Skills and Experience: Ideally minimum three years' compliance experience in regulated financial services. Working knowledge of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book and AML/CFT Code 2019. Recognised compliance qualification such as the ICA Diploma in Compliance, the CISI Diploma in Investment Compliance or equivalent. Based in the Isle of Man. Track record of direct FSA engagement. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16832

Notes
The successful candidate will join Be Well Physiotherapy & Pilates, a busy and growing clinic in Douglas, Isle of Man, specialising in Women’s Health, Pelvic Health and musculoskeletal physiotherapy. Initially, the role will involve taking over an established caseload during the clinic owner’s maternity leave, with the opportunity to continue in a permanent full-time position thereafter.

Key responsibilities will include managing a varied physiotherapy caseload, conducting thorough assessments, developing individualised treatment and rehabilitation programmes, and providing high-quality, patient-centred care.

Applicants must be HCPC-registered physiotherapists with a passion for clinical excellence, strong communication skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team. An interest in or experience of musculoskeletal physiotherapy and Women’s Health would be advantageous. Full-time hours are available, although working patterns are negotiable, with potential flexibility around school hours.

The successful applicant must be willing to relocate to the Isle of Man and have a valid UK passport or appropriate visa/right to work.

To apply, please email your CV and a brief covering letter outlining your experience and interest in the position to Sanchia Newman at **sanchia@bewell.im**. Shortlisted applicants will be contacted to arrange an online meeting to discuss the role and opportunity further. For enquiries, please contact Sanchia by email at the address above.

Additional Pilates qualifications, particularly in Mat and Reformer Pilates, would be a bonus and provide an opportunity to contribute to our established and busy Pilates programme.

Kinrades Pharmacy is looking for a friendly, reliable and enthusiastic Medicines Counter Assistant to join our team. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys helping people and wants to make a positive difference in their local community.

You will be a welcoming first point of contact for customers, offering attentive service and supporting the smooth running of the pharmacy. Your duties will include helping customers with everyday healthcare enquiries, selling suitable over-the-counter products within your training, and referring questions to the pharmacist when appropriate.

You will also handle payments, replenish stock, check expiry dates and keep the shop clean, organised and well presented. Respecting customer confidentiality and following pharmacy procedures are essential parts of the role.

We are looking for someone with clear communication skills, a caring approach and good attention to detail. You should be comfortable working as part of a team, willing to learn and able to remain calm during busy periods.

Previous retail or pharmacy experience would be helpful, but enthusiasm and a commitment to excellent customer service are equally important. A willingness to undertake relevant medicines counter training is essential.

To apply, please send your CV and a brief covering letter to Sarah at hello@kinradespharmacy.co.uk

We offer a competitive salary, ongoing training, career development, staff discounts and a supportive team within a forward-thinking independent pharmacy.

Notes
We are looking to recruit experienced health care assistants to join our team at Silverdale Care Home. 
As a Health Care Assistant your role is to provide dignified and individualised support to older people who may require extra assistance. You will work as part of an established team providing support to our residents with day to day care. You will need to be a kind, caring individual who likes to provide care and support helping others. Principal Duties Include: To assist in providing highest standards of personal care and attention for the residents. To assist with personal hygiene as per care plan. Providing support at mealtimes, helping to serve meals, prepare tables. Promote independence and wellbeing of our residents. To be polite and helpful at all times i.e. appropriate conduct and attitude towards the residents, visitors and colleagues at all times.
We are offering day shifts only at this stage. You will work an average of 38.5 hours a week. This role is physically demanding but also provides the opportunity to learn and grow and ensure that our residents are provided with a high standard of person-centred care. A full induction programme will be provided upon commencement of employment. 
We provide an ongoing training programme throughout each year to promote professional development.
We will require an enhanced DBS check.  Uniform is provided. If you are interested in applying for this position, please contact Michelle on email office@silverdalecare.com to request the application form.

We are seeking friendly and resilient Additional Support Workers to join us across all our services. We have over 9 different houses located both in Eastern and Central parts of the Island where they are located within easy reach of local bus routes. You will be joining a friendly, established team that provides quality support to autistic adults.

We are looking for people who will bring their passion and enthusiasm to the role. Autism Initiatives provide specialist support for people with autism and we are committed to working in partnership to achieve the best possible outcomes.

As an Additional Support Worker you will support with a range of activities which meet the wishes of the people that we support and encourages people with autism to live as independently as possible and be part of their local community. Activities could include: swimming, accessing day trips, gardening, walking groups and many more.

The role of an Additional Support Worker enables you to accept shifts around your availability and other commitments. For more information, or to apply, please visit jobs.autisminitiatives.org.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

Notes
Join a brilliant team on the Isle of Man, committed to supporting autistic people to live as independently as possible and to be part of their local community. Autism Initiatives work positively alongside people with autism, providing specialist services that are tailored to each individual.

We are seeking friendly Support Workers to join us at our Residential services. We have a number of houses located in Central and Northern parts of the Island within easy reach of local bus routes.

We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic and will enjoy joining a team that encourages people with autism to enjoy an active lifestyle. Community activities could include swimming, accessing walking groups or trips to the cinema or even camping trips and gorge walking. Support Workers promote health and well-being and support individuals to maintain their home. The support we deliver is flexible and unique to each individual, building on their strengths and driven by their goals.

Experience is not essential, but a genuine desire to making a difference to the lives of people with autism, as well as a positive attitude is. This is truly a rewarding role, with the opportunity for you to develop your skills, knowledge and fulfil your career aspirations.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

For more information, or to apply, please visit jobs.autisminitiatives.org.

Here at Costa Coffee, we want to inspire the world to love great coffee. We’re all about embracing passion, energy and teamwork as we serve memorable moments for every one of our customers. In this role, you’ll be the perfect partner in setting up the store for success. 
A bit about the role 

Working closely with the Store Manager, you’ll help make sure that everything about the store is efficient and effective. That means getting involved in operations, store and company culture, customer relationships, and of course, the coffee. 

What’s involved?   Becoming a brand ambassador and helping us shine; Leading the team to deliver an unbeatable coffee experience for every customer; Overseeing all aspects of operations, from cash and stock management to Costa standards, policies & procedures to in-store marketing and more; Monitoring the store KPI report and translating it into daily and weekly actions; Managing, growing, coaching, supporting and delegating to the team – all that lovely people stuff

Competitive pay, performance related bonus aligned to meeting key performance indicators, 25 days paid holiday; Free handmade drinks, plus discount on food and bottled drink while on shift .

Notes
Be the warm welcome that makes a stay memorable. The Mannin Hotel is looking for a friendly, professional Hotel Receptionist to support guests from their first enquiry through to departure. You will be a key point of contact, helping the hotel run smoothly while delivering attentive and confident service.
What you will do
Welcome guests warmly, respond to questions and resolve issues promptly, involving the Duty Manager when needed.
Handle booking enquiries and reservations, use the hotel’s reservations system, and recommend hotel services where appropriate.
Answer calls promptly (within three rings where possible), monitor email and Live Messenger, and provide clear, professional replies.
Prepare for arrivals and departures, keep up to date with expected guest numbers, and give a thorough handover between shifts.
Check guest invoices and charges, take payment in line with instructions, and follow procedures for recording and filing daily takings.
Work closely with other hotel departments, handle guest information carefully, and keep the reception workspace clean and tidy.
Build knowledge of the Isle of Man, its attractions and events, and follow hotel health, safety, fire and service procedures.
What we are looking for
A naturally welcoming manner and a genuine commitment to good guest service.
Clear communication, a professional telephone manner and confidence handling questions or concerns.
Good attention to detail when managing bookings, payments, messages and guest information.
A calm, organised approach and the ability to work well with colleagues across the hotel.
Local knowledge is essential, along with confidence using computer systems or willingness to learn.
The role
You will report to the General Manager, Reservations Manager and Duty Manager. The role includes shifts at weekends and at other times required by the needs of the hotel. 8 hour shifts from 7am to 10pm. 
Interested?
To apply, please email victoria@manninhotel.im directly with your CV and a short introduction. Please include your availability and relevant experience.

Notes
An exciting opportunity to help establish and potentially run a new Asian takeaway business!

We are looking for experienced and enthusiastic Chinese or Asian cuisine chefs to join us in launching a new takeaway business in Douglas.

The premises have recently been refurbished and are fully equipped with a professional commercial kitchen, including equipment suitable for traditional Chinese cooking, wok cooking and a variety of Asian dishes.

We are interested in hearing from experienced chefs, individuals or even a small team who have the skills, knowledge and enthusiasm to help create a successful takeaway business.

This opportunity could be much more than just a job!

We are particularly interested in speaking to someone who may have ambitions to run their own takeaway business but would benefit from having the premises, equipment and business support already in place.

For the right individual or team, there may be an opportunity to enter into a joint venture or business partnership, with the possibility of sharing responsibility for developing and running the business.

What we are looking for

Experienced Chinese or Asian cuisine chefs.

Strong knowledge of authentic Asian cooking.

Experience in wok cooking, stir-frying and takeaway food preparation.

Ability to develop menus and maintain food quality.

Someone reliable, motivated and commercially minded.

Experience managing or running a takeaway would be an advantage.

What we can offer

Newly refurbished takeaway premises in Douglas.

Fully equipped commercial kitchen.

Opportunity to help establish a new business.

Employment opportunities for experienced chefs.

Potential joint venture or business partnership.

Support from an established local food business.

An opportunity to build something together.

Interested?

Whether you are an experienced chef looking for employment, an established takeaway operator looking for a new opportunity, or someone who would like to run their own business, we would love to hear from you.

We are open-minded about the right arrangement and would welcome conversations with individuals or teams interested in working together.

Please get in touch with details of your experience, skills and what you would be looking for from this opportunity. EMAIL   Saxman_6@hotmail   in strict confidence

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Sous Chef to join our Kitchen Team. The successful candidate will be passionate about food, thrive under pressure, and maintain the highest standards of food hygiene and safety while delivering creative, fresh, and locally inspired menus.

Key Responsibilities of the Role:

Work efficiently in a fast paced environment while maintaining a positive attitude.

Prepare, cook, and present dishes within the Kitchen to a high standard.

Help train and mentor junior kitchen staff.

Ensure full compliance with food hygiene and safety regulations.

Maintain cleaning schedules, temperature checks, and allergen controls.

Assist in managing stock control, supplier relationships, and kitchen budgeting.

Ensure all Health & Safety policies are followed, including COSHH.

Ideal Requirements for the Role:
Previous experience as a Sous Chef, ideally 2 years.

Up to date Level 3 (or higher) Food Safety & Hygiene certification.

In depth knowledge of Health & Safety policies, COSHH and allergen regulations.

A passion for quality food and kitchen cleanliness.

Organised, reliable, and calm under pressure.

If you would like to be considered for the role please email your CV to kwatson@ramseyparkhotel.com

Notes
Barista Costa Coffee Sea Terminal,  ready for the next level?

At Costa Coffee, we are what we craft. It's about perfecting latte art, creating experiences that put a smile on people's faces, and proudly making greatness every day. 

We’re passionate about being a great place to work with our Sea Terminal store, where you can bring your real self into our mix.    Making our drinks with heart, giving our customers a warm welcome and a lasting impression so they come back to our stores and enjoy an exceptional experience. 

What you’ll do.  Being a Barista means so much more than making velvety cups of joy. It’s your chance to learn, challenge yourself and truly master your craft the Costa Way - which means you’ll be: Putting smiles on faces come rain or shine; Mastering our menu, from toasties to seasonal drinks and more; Pouring passion into perfect drinks and great customer service; Keeping your store clean, tidy and welcoming; Working with your colleagues to make our stores the very best. 

Who you are?   You will be a Barista with at least 2 years experience who has mastered the bar or have worked for at least 2 years in a similar hospitality environment.  You will be ambitious, love to lead by example to create a collaborative team culture and are ready for the next step to be mentored for progression from Barista to Shift Leader and Assistant Manager.  

We’re interested in your unique ingredients:  A multi-tasker with a can-do attitude; not afraid to take on a challenge; A perfectionist, dedicated to delivering excellence; A people person and a team player, who can strike up a good conversation, lead and inspire to drive exceptional performance to exceed our Key Performance Indicators.   You will be passionate about hospitality and creating great guest experiences.    

What we can offer: We’re really proud of the work our team members deliver, and we want you to feel valued and rewarded.   Our starting rate is £12.86 p/h, increasing upon progression from Barista to Shift leader and Assistant Manager.   Free hot and cold drinks on shift, plus discount on food and bottled drinks. 20 days paid holiday increasing to 25 days, Recognition and performance related rewards. 

Please email your CV and covering letter outlining why you wish to become part of the Costa Team to hrteam@fancyacoffee.im

Barista Costa Ramsey Stores, ready for the next level?

At Costa Coffee, we are what we craft. It's about perfecting latte art, creating experiences that put a smile on people's faces, and proudly making greatness every day. 

We’re passionate about being a great place to work across both our stores in Ramsey, where you can bring your real self into our mix.    Making our drinks with heart, giving our customers a warm welcome and a lasting impression so they come back to our stores and enjoy an exceptional experience. 

What you’ll do.  Being a Barista means so much more than making velvety cups of joy. It’s your chance to learn, challenge yourself and truly master your craft the Costa Way - which means you’ll be: Putting smiles on faces come rain or shine; Mastering our menu, from toasties to seasonal drinks and more; Pouring passion into perfect drinks and great customer service; Keeping your store clean, tidy and welcoming; Working with your colleagues to make our stores the very best. 

Who you are?   You will be a Barista with at least 2 years experience who has mastered the bar or have worked for at least 2 years in a similar hospitality environment.  You will be ambitious, love to lead by example to create a collaborative team culture and are ready for the next step to be mentored for progression from Barista to Shift Leader and Assistant Manager.  

We’re interested in your unique ingredients:  A multi-tasker with a can-do attitude; not afraid to take on a challenge; A perfectionist, dedicated to delivering excellence; A people person and a team player, who can strike up a good conversation, lead and inspire to drive exceptional performance to exceed our Key Performance Indicators.   You will be passionate about hospitality and creating great guest experiences.    

What we can offer: We’re really proud of the work our team members deliver, and we want you to feel valued and rewarded.   Our starting rate is £12.86 p/h, increasing upon progression from Barista to Shift leader and Assistant Manager.   Free hot and cold drinks on shift, plus discount on food and bottled drinks. 20 days paid holiday increasing to 25 days, Recognition and performance related rewards. 

Please email your CV and covering letter outlining why you wish to become part of the Costa Team to hrteam@fancyacoffee.im

We’re recruiting a Head Chef to lead our restaurant and events kitchen across a mix of daytime, evening and weekend shifts. The role covers brunch, lunch, restaurant dining and private events, with responsibility for maintaining exceptional standards, consistency and a calm, organised working environment.

You’ll oversee all aspects of kitchen operations, ensuring dishes are prepared and presented to specification and that service runs smoothly during busy periods. Leading and developing the kitchen team will be central to the role, building confidence, skill and professionalism across all levels. You’ll take ownership of menu development, bringing creativity and seasonality to both core menus and specials, while ensuring everything aligns with the venue’s identity and expectations.

The position includes managing ordering, stock control, GP targets and supplier relationships, along with maintaining food hygiene, safety and compliance standards. Strong attention to detail, a structured approach to organisation and a commitment to cleanliness are essential. You’ll work closely with the wider management team to support planning, communication and the overall guest experience.

This is an opportunity to take a leading role in a well?regarded venue with a varied service offering, a supportive team and room to shape the future direction of the kitchen.

If this feels like the right next step, we’d welcome your application via email to our General Manager at neil@kellas.im

WE’RE HIRING  SOUS CHEF MILNTOWN
We’re looking for an experienced Sous Chef to join our kitchen team here at Milntown. 
We want someone who can bring their own experience, ideas and skills to the kitchen, work closely with our Head Chef and complement the great team we already have. 
What we can offer:
Competitive rates of pay
Paid overtime or time off in lieu
Sociable working hours, predominantly daytime
No split shifts
Usually the same two days off together each week (Monday & Tuesday) for most of the year 
20 days annual leave plus 10 bank holidays
Only occasional evening work for functions and events
A varied working environment, from our busy café and Sunday carvery to weddings, private functions and TT hospitality 
We know how demanding working in a kitchen can be, and we want to offer a role where you can enjoy your work while still having a good work-life balance. 
Perhaps you’re already a Sous Chef looking for a change, or a Head Chef who would prefer a little less responsibility and more sociable hours, whilst still playing an active role in the running of the kitchen. 
Above all, we're looking for someone who works well as part of a team, takes pride in what they do and wants to bring their experience and enthusiasm to an already established kitchen. 
An immediate start is available, although we're happy to consider candidates with a notice period. 
Interested? We’d love to hear from you. 
Please send your CV or a little information about yourself to estateoffice@milntown.orgor get in touch for an informal chat.

An exciting opportunity to help establish and potentially run a new Asian takeaway business!

We are looking for experienced and enthusiastic Chinese or Asian cuisine chefs to join us in launching a new takeaway business in Douglas.

The premises have recently been refurbished and are fully equipped with a professional commercial kitchen, including equipment suitable for traditional Chinese cooking, wok cooking and a variety of Asian dishes.

We are interested in hearing from experienced chefs, individuals or even a small team who have the skills, knowledge and enthusiasm to help create a successful takeaway business.

This opportunity could be much more than just a job!

We are particularly interested in speaking to someone who may have ambitions to run their own takeaway business but would benefit from having the premises, equipment and business support already in place.

For the right individual or team, there may be an opportunity to enter into a joint venture or business partnership, with the possibility of sharing responsibility for developing and running the business.

What we are looking for

Experienced Chinese or Asian cuisine chefs.

Strong knowledge of authentic Asian cooking.

Experience in wok cooking, stir-frying and takeaway food preparation.

Ability to develop menus and maintain food quality.

Someone reliable, motivated and commercially minded.

Experience managing or running a takeaway would be an advantage.

What we can offer

Newly refurbished takeaway premises in Douglas.

Fully equipped commercial kitchen.

Opportunity to help establish a new business.

Employment opportunities for experienced chefs.

Potential joint venture or business partnership.

Support from an established local food business.

An opportunity to build something together.

Interested?

Whether you are an experienced chef looking for employment, an established takeaway operator looking for a new opportunity, or someone who would like to run their own business, we would love to hear from you.

We are open-minded about the right arrangement and would welcome conversations with individuals or teams interested in working together.

Please get in touch with details of your experience, skills and what you would be looking for from this opportunity. EMAIL   Saxman_6@hotmail   in strict confidence

The Role:
As a Shift Supervisor at Crema, you're the leader on shift. You'll run the floor, support your team, hold standards and make sure every customer leaves with a brilliant experience, even when it's busy, short-staffed or challenging.
This is a step up from Barista and the start of a real leadership journey. Most of our Assistant Managers and Store Managers have come through this role. If you want to grow with us, this is where it starts.

What You'll Be Doing:
Leading the store during your shift, deploying the team, maintaining pace and making sure standards are met from open to close.
Coaching and supporting Baristas in the moment, not just when there's a problem.
Delivering an exceptional customer experience and dealing with complaints confidently and professionally.
Holding health and safety, food safety and operational standards every shift, without exception.
Making confident decisions when things don't go to plan, without always needing to escalate.
Recognising good work and creating a positive, focused environment on shift.
Communicating clearly with the rest of the management team about what's happening in store.
Supporting new team members through their training and onboarding.

What We're Looking For:
Previous experience in a customer-facing role, ideally in hospitality or food service.
A natural leader, someone people look to, even without the title.
Calm under pressure with the ability to prioritise and make decisions quickly.
High standards and the consistency to hold them even when it's hard.
A genuine interest in developing others.
Clear, confident communication with both customers and colleagues.

What You'll Get:
Free hand-crafted beverages on shift.
30% discount on food and bottled beverages while on shift.
30% discount on all items while off shift, across all participating stores (not exclusive to Crema).
25 days holiday entitlement.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Program, access to free sanitary products while at work, team building summer and winter event.
Real progression opportunities, we promote from within wherever we can.
A team that looks out for each other.

Crema are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All applicants will be treated fairly, without regard to race, religion, sex, nationality, age, disability, sexual orientation, marital status or gender identity.

For more details and to apply contact darren.kerruish@cafefortune.uk

We’re looking for an experienced and passionate Head Chef to lead a busy hospitality kitchen, delivering consistently great food while creating a positive, well-organised environment for the team.

You’ll take ownership of the day-to-day kitchen operation, including food quality and presentation, team leadership and development, stock and ordering, food costs and wastage, menu development, and maintaining excellent standards of food safety, hygiene and kitchen compliance.

You’ll ideally have previous experience as a Head Chef, Kitchen Manager or experienced Sous Chef, together with a recognised professional cookery qualification such as NVQ Level 2/3, City & Guilds or equivalent, although substantial industry experience will also be considered.

A recognised Food Safety/Food Hygiene qualification is required, along with a good working knowledge of HACCP, allergen management and kitchen health & safety. You’ll also be confident managing stock, controlling costs and leading and developing a kitchen team.

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who is hands-on, organised and passionate about great food, with the confidence to take ownership of their kitchen and lead from the front.

Whether you’re an established Head Chef or an experienced Sous Chef ready to take the next step, we’d love to hear from you.

Notes
Are you an experienced Environment Manager looking to take ownership of a complex, business critical technology landscape?

IFGL is seeking an Environment Manager to lead the governance, planning and operational management of our development, test and pre-production environments across both on premise and Azure cloud platforms. Reporting to the Head of IT Delivery, you will play a key role in enabling reliable, high-quality software delivery across multiple products, teams and suppliers. 

The main duties for the role holder will include:
Define, own and evolve IFGL's environment management strategy and roadmap.
Manage the full lifecycle of development, test and pre-production environments.
Ensure environments are stable, available and ready to support delivery, testing and release activities.
Coordinate environment demand, scheduling and capacity across multiple teams and suppliers.
Drive standardisation, governance and continuous improvement across the environment estate.
Work closely with DevOps, Testing, Architecture, Infrastructure and third-party partners to improve delivery outcomes. 
To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidates will need to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
Proven experience managing complex IT environments across multiple platforms and suppliers.
Strong understanding of environment lifecycle management, SDLC and software delivery practices.
Experience supporting Agile and Waterfall delivery teams.
Experience supporting DevOps practices, including environment automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), release planning and deployment activities.
Excellent stakeholder management, planning and problem solving skills.
Knowledge of hybrid infrastructure environments, including Azure cloud technologies.
Ideally has financial services regulatory/compliance knowledge.

If you or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward a current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com 

We encourage and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds because we embrace diversity and inclusivity within our business.

Closing date for this vacancy will be 27 November 2026.

Notes
To Apply for the Role, please follow the following link - 
https://apogeecorp.ciphr-irecruit.com/applicants/vacancy/840/Technical-Consultant---3rd-Line

As a 3rd Line Support Technician, you are a senior escalation point within Apogee’s support model. You will handle the most complex incidents that cannot be resolved by 1st or 2nd line teams, while also taking ownership of infrastructure stability, technical improvements, and project delivery.

You will work independently and collaboratively on infrastructure changes, new deployments, and onboarding new customers. You will also play a key role in setting standards, improving documentation, and feeding knowledge back into the wider support teams.

This role suits someone who enjoys depth, responsibility, and working at enterprise scale.

What you will be doing
Acting as a final escalation point for complex technical issues
Maintaining and improving customer IT infrastructure, including patching and upgrades
Designing, implementing, and supporting technical solutions across server, cloud, and network environments
Contributing to infrastructure change, system improvements, and new deployments
Supporting client onboarding and producing high-quality technical documentation
Providing guidance and technical direction to 1st and 2nd line teams
Working within change control and service management processes
Supporting customers professionally via phone, email, and self-service portals
Participating in an on-call rota (up to one week in every four)
Continuing technical development through training and certifications

A typical working pattern is Monday to Friday, 08:30 to 17:30, with a one-hour lunch break. This role also offers flexibility to work from home, typically two days per week for a five-day working week

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
You will be a confident 3rd Line engineer with strong Microsoft, infrastructure, and networking capability, and experience working in enterprise or public sector environments.

Essential technical experience includes:
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 and Azure
Strong experience in SCCM System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM)
Proven ability to implement and manage Microsoft Entra, Intune, Autopilot, and Defender
Strong working knowledge of Windows Server environments (2016+), including AD, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and RDS
Experience maintaining Hybrid Active Directory environments
Experience with virtualisation platforms such as Hyper-V or VMware
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including VLANs, routing, firewalls, and WiFi
Experience working as a 3rd line escalation point within a tiered support model
Strong awareness of IT security best practice
We value candidates with AI literacy – individuals who are curious about technology, comfortable exploring automation, and eager to contribute to a modern, forward-thinking business.

Our client seeks a Data Engineer to join their team on a 12 Month fixed contract. Role Profile: You will be a key member of a small team of Data Engineers, contributing not only to the delivery of the solution but also helping shape its future direction. As we shift from building the data warehousing project to maintaining and evolving it, you'll play a crucial role in defining your own path by generalising capabilities, streamlining processes, and optimising for long-term impact. Join the team in modernising the data ecosystem by building fast, scalable, cloud-first solutions with Microsoft Azure, revolutionizing data warehousing, business intelligence, and operational reporting capabilities. Transforming how decisions are made, moving from legacy reports to real-time intelligence. A good data solution enables business users to explore ideas and make informed choices quickly and effectively. Key Responsibilities: Approach problems, familiar and novel, with thoughtful solutions. Balance immediate tasks with broader, strategic goals. Configure data pipelines and services using Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, and other tooling. Integrate legacy systems pragmatically as we transition to tomorrow's cloud-first architecture. Apply appropriate data modelling techniques to enable reporting and integration use cases. Grow your domain expertise through collaboration with analysts and stakeholders. Contribute to agile delivery: sizing work, refining tasks, and supporting teammates. Key Skills and Experience:  Microsoft Azure cloud services. SQL Server databases, with strong T-SQL proficiency. Git source control. Programming in C#, Java, Python or JavaScript. Agile software delivery. Azure Synapse Analytics or Azure Data Factory. DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, automated deployment. SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) or SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS). Microsoft PowerBI. Data modelling approaches: Data Vault 2.0 or Kimball - Desirable. Secure development and deployment practices - Desirable. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16884

Notes
Key responsibilities

The Senior SMS Software Developer will join Clay’s development team and work across our software development projects and client engagements, with a strong focus on communication-platform (CPaaS) and messaging technology. The role involves designing, developing and maintaining scalable backend applications, microservices and APIs, and building and maintaining communication-platform and messaging services including SMS, WhatsApp, email and one-time-PIN. The successful candidate will integrate with telecommunications carriers, messaging providers and third-party platforms, define software architecture, coding standards and engineering best practice, and lead technical design reviews. They will also improve platform resilience, observability and automated testing, mentor other developers, carry out code reviews, and support production troubleshooting. This is a hands-on, office-based senior engineering role in Douglas, working 40 hours per week.

Skills and experience required

This is a specialist role, and applicants must be able to demonstrate all of the essential requirements to be considered. These are strong, demonstrable commercial experience in C# and .NET; hands-on development of SMPP (Short Message Peer-to-Peer) messaging services; working knowledge of telecoms signalling protocols, specifically SS7; experience building and operating high-throughput, high-availability communication-platform (CPaaS) and messaging systems such as SMS, WhatsApp and one-time-PIN; designing and building secure, high-performance RESTful APIs and real-time services; strong SQL Server or PostgreSQL and message queuing such as RabbitMQ; and typically seven or more years of senior software development experience. Experience building enterprise-grade CPaaS platforms, cloud (AWS or Azure), Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD, and a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field are desirable. Beyond the technical skills, we are looking for someone with excellent attention to detail, a team attitude built on honesty, integrity and trust, curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning, a problem-solving mindset, excellent written and verbal communication, and the adaptability, proactivity and ownership to thrive in a changing environment.

How to apply

To apply, please send your CV and a short covering letter by email to hello@clay.co.im

Fansuite Limited is an Isle of Man company building a new platform for the creator economy. We are looking for a Head of Engineering to lead the technical side of the business as we build, launch and scale the platform. This is a permanent, full-time role based in Ballasalla, Isle of Man.

You will own the engineering function end to end, from setting the technical direction and architecture of the platform through to development, release and day-to-day operation. This covers hosting and infrastructure, security, data protection, uptime and integrations such as payment processing. You will manage external development agencies and contractors, build an in-house team as the business grows, and work closely with senior leadership on product, budget and planning.

You will need at least 10 years’ experience in software engineering, including time in a senior or lead role. A degree in computer science or a related discipline is preferred, though equivalent experience will be considered. Experience in a start-up, or in subscription, marketplace or creator platforms, would be an advantage.

To apply, please email your CV and a short covering note setting out your relevant experience to tim@fansuite.com. The closing date for applications is 3 December 2026.

Feel Connected to the future at Sure by joining as a Fixed Mobile Convergence (FMC) Network Performance Lead, working 37.5 hours per week.

To drive the role forward, the individual will support the CIIM Mobile Core and RAN (Radio Access Network) network, in addition to leading RAN optimisation across the CIIM RAN. The successful applicant will be responsible for the evolution, operations and maintenance of Sure’s Mobile network components including RAN and Core, whilst supporting the wider business with analytics and mobile performance information. Please note, applicants must have RAN and Core Network Experience.

Sure are looking for candidates who would like to feel connected to future technologies and change, global opportunities, personal development, and working in a great team. Passionate about their people and communities, the ideal individual would hold the following skills:

Strong understanding of 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G mobile networking and associated core.
Strong understanding of mobile network performance management and RAN optimisation principles, including accessibility, retainability, mobility, integrity, availability and capacity KPIs.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret network datasets, identify performance trends and anomalies, correlate KPIs and determine likely root causes.
Understanding of AI/ML and their application to telecom network operations, optimisation and troubleshooting.
We are proud of the “way we do things” at Sure; We work together as One Team, We strive for Customer Satisfaction, We are Reliable, We have a Passion for Technology & Learning and We are Community & Sustainability Focused, and individuals applying will “feel connected” to our Company values.

You will be joining a Company that is committed to developing highly engaged professional employees, offering a competitive remuneration package, as well as great staff benefits:

Free Ultrafast Broadband,
Free Unlimited Max mobile contract,
Generous bonus scheme,
Healthcare
Company pension
Parking/Bicycle facilities 
To apply, please send CVs to recruitment@sure.com.
