Notes
Our client seeks an experienced AI Systems Architect to join their team. You will take ownership of the Company's entire AI and automation agenda: identifying process improvement opportunities, integrating AI tools with the ERP system, automating workflows, establishing governance frameworks, and rolling out successful solutions across a global network. It is a high-visibility, high-impact role with real scope for career progression. This is not a role for a traditional IT professional, and to be considered, candidates should be able to demonstrate examples of AI solutions they have personally designed, implemented and deployed within a business environment, outlining the challenges addressed and the tangible outcomes achieved. Key Responsibilities: Develop and implement a comprehensive AI and automation roadmap aligned with business priorities. Review existing processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and staff productivity. Design and integrate AI tools with the ERP system and other core business applications. Automate repetitive tasks and improve access to business-critical information. Manage projects end-to-end, from initial concept through testing, implementation, and ongoing refinement. Establish clear policies and governance frameworks covering data security, responsible use, reliability, and human oversight. Deliver practical training, guidance, and ongoing support to colleagues at all levels. Evaluate emerging technologies and suppliers to identify the most suitable solutions. Measure the impact of improvements and share successful approaches across the global network. Key Skills and Experience: Significant demonstrable experience designing and implementing AI, automation, or integrated business systems. Strong understanding of ERP systems, business process improvement, and application/data integration. The ability to combine technical depth with a practical, solutions-focused approach to business problems. A proven track record of turning ideas into reliable, user-friendly solutions. Solid knowledge of data security principles, AI governance, and responsible AI frameworks. Clear, confident communication with stakeholders at all levels. Experience within engineering, manufacturing, or an international business environment is advantageous. If you are ready to take ownership of something truly meaningful and build a career with international scope, we want to hear from you. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16941

Our client seeks a Credit Analyst to join their risk team. Role Profile: Responsible for managing a portfolio of counterparty credit risks associated with lending, trading and investment activities. The successful candidate will play a key role in assessing, monitoring and managing credit risk within approved risk appetite. Responsibilities: Critically assess valuation assumptions, sustainable cash flows, loan-to-value, debt-service and interest-cover metrics, lease profile, tenant quality, vacancy, break options and marketability. Design or challenge fit-for-purpose security packages, guarantees, cessions, mortgage or other collateral arrangements, intercreditor terms and enforcement priorities. Make credit decisions and recommendations in line with applicable lending policies, regulatory requirements and sound credit risk principles. Identify and mitigate credit risks through appropriate security structures, facility conditions and ongoing portfolio monitoring. Build strong relationships with business stakeholders and act as a trusted advisor on credit matters. Key Skills and Experience: Essential: Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Commerce or a related discipline. 5-7 years' experience in credit assessment, credit risk decisioning and lending within banking or financial services. Strong understanding of financial statements, repayment structures, collateral management and credit processes. jobs.fullDescription:

Salary
£65,000 - £80,000
End Date
30 November 2026
Notes
Key Responsibilities

The Group ITSM Manager will own and maintain the Group IT Service Management framework, policies, standards and procedures, and will lead the continual improvement of Change, Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Request, Alert and Knowledge Management. The role will establish clear processes, responsibilities and operating procedures across the Group, including effective IT onboarding and offboarding processes.

The role will oversee the governance, administration and development of Freshservice, including workflows, automation, access and configuration. Responsibility will also include maintaining effective Asset and Configuration Management practices across on-premises and cloud environments and improving the integration of monitoring and alerting with ITSM and Major Incident processes.

The Group ITSM Manager will define and monitor service measures, service levels and performance indicators, providing clear reporting on service performance, trends and operational risks. The role will work closely with regional teams and third-party providers to maintain consistent service standards and lead service improvement initiatives across the Group.

Skills and Experience
Essential

Applicants should have significant practical experience in IT Service Management within a complex or multi-location organisation, together with a strong working knowledge of ITIL 4. They should have experience owning and improving ITSM policies, processes and procedures, and administering or configuring an ITSM platform such as Freshservice, ServiceNow or Jira Service Management.

Relevant experience should include service catalogue design, workflows, automation, incident management, and Asset and Configuration Management across on-premises and cloud environments. Applicants should also demonstrate strong analytical, reporting and problem-solving skills, together with effective communication and stakeholder management skills.

Experience working with technical teams, business stakeholders and third-party providers is required, together with an understanding of governance, risk, compliance and audit requirements relating to IT operations. Applicants should hold ITIL 4 Foundation certification or be able to demonstrate an equivalent level of knowledge and relevant practical experience.

Desirable

Experience administering Freshservice would be advantageous, as would ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader certification. Relevant service management or governance qualifications, such as COBIT or ISO/IEC 20000, and recognised project management qualifications, such as PRINCE2, PMP or AgilePM, would also be beneficial.

Additional desirable experience includes ITSM platform certification, Microsoft Azure, AWS or equivalent cloud fundamentals certification, and experience working with application programming interfaces and system integrations.

For more details and to apply contact hfitchet@tridenttrust.com

Notes
Feel Connected to the future at Sure by joining the Consumer team as a Senior Commercial Manager working 37.5 hours per week.

To drive the role forward, the individual will lead the Consumer commercial agenda, turning strategy into clear priorities and measurable trading outcomes across the Channel Islands and Isle of Man. Leading the commercial team across CVM, Mobile, Home and Devices, the role brings together customer value, portfolio performance, revenue and margin, market insight and commercial priorities into one coherent trading plan. This is a commercially accountable role rather than a reporting or analyst function. 

Sure are looking for candidates who would like to feel connected to future technologies and change, global opportunities, personal development, and working in a great team. Passionate about their people and communities, the ideal individual would hold the following skills:

Strong management experience in a consumer, subscription, telecoms or similarly competitive environment. 
Demonstrable experience managing revenue, margin, customer and portfolio performance. 
Strong commercial judgement and ability to balance revenue, margin, customer and operational considerations. 
Strong leadership capability with experience bringing together multiple commercial disciplines into a coherent trading agenda. 
 

We are proud of the “way we do things” at Sure; We work together as One Team, We strive for Customer Satisfaction, We are Reliable, We have a Passion for Technology & Learning and We are Community & Sustainability Focused, and individuals applying will “feel connected” to our Company values.

You will be joining a Company that is committed to developing highly engaged professional employees, offering a competitive remuneration package, as well as great staff benefits:

Free Ultrafast Broadband,
Free Unlimited Max mobile contract,
Generous bonus scheme,
Healthcare
Company pension
Parking/Bicycle facilities 
To apply, please send CVs to recruitment@sure.com.

Notes
Location: Isle of Man (On-site, five days per week): MayFly Entertainment is a licensed gambling operator regulated by the Isle of Man Gambling Supervision Commission (GSC). For over ten years, we have provided online sports betting and casino products while maintaining high standards of integrity, transparency and player protection. We are seeking a Senior Marketing Manager to lead the development and execution of acquisition marketing strategies across Asian markets, with a particular focus on Welcome Offer and Refer-a-Friend programmes. This role is responsible for driving new player growth, expanding affiliate reach and strengthening brand presence across multiple Asian territories. Working closely with Marketing, CRM, Affiliates, HVC and Customer Operations teams, you will oversee campaign delivery, optimise marketing investment and ensure all activity supports sustainable growth and strong commercial performance. Key Responsibilities: Develop and deliver acquisition campaigns focused on Welcome Offer and Refer-a-Friend initiatives to drive player and affiliate growth. Manage marketing budgets and investment to maximise return on investment while ensuring spend aligns with business objectives. Analyse campaign performance and customer data to identify opportunities, improve results and inform future activity. Strengthen brand awareness through targeted marketing initiatives across Asian markets. Ensure consistent brand messaging and customer experience across all channels and touchpoints. Monitor market trends, competitor activity and customer behaviour to maintain a competitive advantage. Collaborate with Affiliate, CRM, HVC, Customer Support and wider Marketing teams to align campaigns with business goals. Drive effective cross-functional communication to ensure campaigns are executed efficiently and deliver measurable results. Skills and Experience: Previous experience in marketing, acquisition campaigns and performance-focused marketing environments. Understanding of regional marketing activity, ideally across Asian markets. Strong commercial awareness with the ability to balance brand objectives, customer growth and marketing investment. Ability to analyse campaign data and translate insights into practical recommendations. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Familiarity with digital marketing platforms, social media channels and CRM systems. Proactive approach to problem-solving, optimisation and continuous improvement. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business or a related field. Fluency in Mandarin would be desirable, and additional Asian language skills would be advantageous. Our Hiring Process: Our interview process is designed to be a two-way conversation, giving you the opportunity to learn more about us while we get to know you. We encourage candidates to ask questions and be curious throughout the process. Please apply to recruitment@mayflyentertainment.com.

Notes
An Extraordinary Board Opportunity Has Landed on the Isle of Man. Search & Select is proud to be partnering with a distinguished international financial services organisation to identify an exceptional individual for a rare and high-impact board-level appointment. Our client is a well-established, internationally respected institution that delivers sophisticated banking, lending, investment, fiduciary and wealth management solutions to globally mobile and affluent clients. Backed by the scale and ambition of one of the worlds most formidable banking groups, this is an organisation with genuine strategic purpose, world-class governance frameworks and a culture that values independent thought, inclusive leadership and constructive challenge. The opportunity: Independent Non-Executive Director (INED) & Board Audit Committee Chair. This is a permanent, board-level appointment carrying both the prestige and the responsibility that come with chairing a Board Audit Committee within a regulated international banking environment. You will bring independent judgement and strategic insight to a high-performing board, while leading the audit committee's oversight of financial reporting, internal and external audit, internal controls and the wider assurance framework. You will also contribute meaningfully to strategy, risk management, regulatory compliance and governance making this a role where your voice truly shapes outcomes. What we are looking for: A proven track record in senior audit, accounting, assurance or audit-governance roles. Previous experience chairing a Board Audit Committee - this is an essential requirement. Strong financial literacy with expertise in financial reporting, internal controls and integrated assurance. Relevant AML/CFT and financial crime experience to challenge management and assess regulatory risk. Previous Independent Non-Executive Director experience within a regulated financial services environment. Type: Permanent. Time Commitment: Minimum 36 days per year. IOM resident and be able to attend board meetings in person .This is a purposeful boardroom environment where independent challenge is not just welcomed it is essential. If you are a credible, commercially aware and values-driven senior leader ready to make a meaningful contribution at board level, we want to hear from you. For a confidential conversation, contact the Search & Select team  or please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16876

Due to continued growth and increased workload, Manx Independent Carriers are looking to recruit an additional experienced mechanic to join our busy workshop. 
This is an excellent opportunity for an HGV Mechanic or Technician looking to join a forward-thinking company with high standards, modern equipment, and a strong focus on compliance, safety, and vehicle reliability. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining and repairing a mixed fleet of HGV vehicles,  trailers and vans ensuring all work is completed to strict company standards. Key responsibilities will be as follows :-
Routine inspection, servicing, and maintenance in line with the fleet planner.
Fault finding, diagnostics, and repairs.
Attending and resolving breakdowns in line with company procedures.
Working to strict health and safety standards.
Accurately completing all maintenance and compliance paperwork.
Updating and maintaining records using computerised maintenance management systems.

Requirements: 
Previous experience as an HGV Technician/Mechanic. 
Strong diagnostic and fault-finding ability.
Good working knowledge of HGVs. 
Understanding of digital maintenance systems.
Commitment to high standards and compliance.
City & Guilds / NVQ Level 3 in Heavy Vehicle Maintenance (or equivalent preferred).
Class 1 (C+E) licence advantageous but not essential.

For more details and to apply contact Gabbie@mic.co.im

Home Help / Nanny–Housekeeper.
Part-Time or Full-Time (Term Time & School Holidays).
We are a busy family looking for a dependable, caring, and organised home help to support our household and care for our two daughters, aged 7 and 10.
We are open to either a part-time role focused on after-school care, or a full-time role combining childcare and household support during term time, with more childcare focus in school holidays.
Part-Time Role – After-School Care.
Responsibilities include:
Collecting our children from school.
Preparing and serving healthy, nutritious meals.
Taking the children to after-school clubs and activities (and getting their bags ready for the clubs).
Ensuring the children are safe, well cared for, and supported after school.
This role would suit someone looking for regular afternoon/evening hours during term time.
Full-Time Role – Nanny–Housekeeper.
Responsibilities include:
All after-school childcare duties listed above.
Helping to run the household on a day-to-day basis.
General housekeeping tasks such as tidying, laundry, shopping, meal preparation and keeping the home organised.
Supporting the smooth running of the household.
During school holidays, the role will place a greater emphasis on childcare, including caring for the children during the day and keeping them engaged and active.
Requirements (Both Roles).
A kind, responsible, and reliable nature.
Experience caring for children of a similar age (preferred).
Ability to prepare healthy meals.
A clean driving licence and use of your own car (Petrol money will be provided as part of the remuneration).
A clean, enhanced DBS check (or willingness to obtain one).
Organised, proactive, and trustworthy.
We Offer:
Choice of part-time or full-time employment.
A friendly family environment.
Competitive pay, depending on experience and hours.
If this role sounds like a good fit for you, we would love to hear from you. Call 07624206008

Sound like your kind of kitchen?

Our client, a well-established business based in central Douglas, is looking for a Client Services Administrator to join its small, friendly team on a full-time, office-based basis. The role starts on a temporary basis as soon as possible and will become permanent for the right candidate, so it suits someone who wants to settle into a long-term position.

You’ll be the first point of contact for the firm’s clients and handle their queries and requests professionally from start to finish. Listening carefully is central to the job, so you’ll need to understand what clients are really asking for and make sure nothing is missed. You’ll work closely with the rest of the team but will also be trusted to think for yourself and use your own judgement.

You’ll have at least two years of office experience, a mature and calm outlook, and excellent attention to detail. Strong IT skills are essential because you’ll move between systems with confidence and pick up new software quickly. The client wants someone who is keen to learn and grow with the business, and who takes real pride in getting things right for clients.

The salary is £28,000 to £30,000 per annum, depending on experience.

To find out more or apply in confidence, call Ambitions on 01624 614841, text or WhatsApp 07624 214841, or email your CV to info@ambitions.co.im. You can also visit www.ambitions.co.im.

Our client seeks a Group FATCA/CRS Reporting Officer to join their team. Role Profile: A key reporting role, based at Group-level, with the opportunity for the successful candidate to step into the world of FATCA/CRS compliance and contribute to an exciting period of transformation, as the Group establishes a central function to manage reporting obligations, pursuant to the United States' Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) and the OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS). You will support the annual end-to-end reporting process, ensuring entity classifications are undertaken in an accurate and timely manner, resultant classifications and associated rationales are logged within the core database, and that Reportable Persons hold valid/reasonable self-certifications, while supporting the Group with AEOI-related queries, escalating where necessary. Key Skills and Responsibilities: A working knowledge of FATCA/CRS and its application to the trust and company sector - pensions an advantage. Ability to complete associated documentation (self-certifications, W-8 and W-9) while explaining the rationale to client-facing teams. Experience of undertaking entity classifications within trust and company structures. Able to work with, understand, and process large volumes of data - CSV, Excel, and XML in particular. A basic understanding of data protection laws and their application to data exchanged under AEOI. 
 For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number:  16932

Our client seeks a Head of Compliance & Risk to join their team. Role Profile: To lead the Group's compliance and risk management framework across its regulated pension trustee and retirement savings account businesses. This is a senior leadership role responsible for developing and maintaining an effective Enterprise Risk Management Framework, overseeing regulatory compliance across the Group's regulated entities and schemes, and ensuring the business remains responsive to evolving legislative and regulatory requirements. The role is not primarily AML/CFT focused however the role does include oversight of this and management of a compliance team of two Isle of Man FTE's, within an established compliance infrastructure including dedicated MLRO, DMLRO and DPO functions. Instead, we are seeking an individual capable of operating strategically across risk, governance and regulation, providing assurance to the Board and supporting the continuing growth of the business. Key Skills and Experience: Significant senior-level experience within compliance, risk or regulatory oversight in a regulated financial services environment. Professional qualification in risk, governance, compliance, audit, legal or financial services disciplines. Strong understanding of Isle of Man Financial Services Authority requirements applicable to licensed financial services businesses. Experience developing and implementing enterprise risk management frameworks. Demonstrable experience interpreting legislation, regulations and regulatory guidance and translating these into practical business solutions. Experience managing regulatory reporting obligations and governance frameworks. Confidence engaging with Boards, Committees, regulators and senior stakeholders. Desirable: Experience within pensions, fiduciary, trustee, retirement savings, wealth management or related financial services sectors. Knowledge of Isle of Man pension legislation and regulatory requirements. Experience implementing regulatory change programmes. ?

Notes
Manavia has a vacancy for a Senior Administrator, eGaming Operations. The role suits a senior eGaming administrator who is looking for a new challenge or ready to take the next step in their career.

About the role
You will be responsible for managing all of the administrative, regulatory and compliance requirements across a portfolio of eGaming clients. You will build close working relationships with the licensed operators you look after, running regular client meetings and supporting them through the licensing process. You will maintain their policies, procedures and regulatory reporting, help to develop and implement the team's processes and procedures, and work across the wider group of companies.

About you
You will have at least three years' experience within the trust and corporate service provider (TCSP) industry, and you will be approved by the Isle of Man Gambling Supervision Commission and Financial Services Authority to act as a director of client companies. You will bring a strong knowledge of eGaming operations, regulation and compliance, and the organisational skills to manage a busy portfolio with minimal supervision. Your written and verbal communication will be strong, and you will be discreet, with a natural ability to build honest, transparent and close working relationships both inside the firm and with clients. You will hold, or be working towards, a relevant professional qualification, or be qualified by experience.

Why join us?
We offer a competitive salary, a friendly working environment and genuine opportunities to progress your career. You will be based in our new offices at 10-12 Victoria Street, Douglas, as part of a team that has grown alongside the Island's eGaming sector.

How to apply
Please send your CV and covering letter to info@manavia.im, or by post to Manavia Limited, 10-12 Victoria Street, Douglas, Isle of Man. To find out more, visit www.manavia.im/careers.

Our client seeks an exceptional Employee Relations, Risk and Benefits Manager to join their People & Culture team. They're known for their culture, strong governance, and genuine commitment to their people - and now they need a seasoned HR leader to continue to drive that mission forward. Key Responsibilities: Provide strategic leadership, guidance, and support to the Head of People and Culture and the broader People and Culture team on all Employee Relations matters. Oversee the efficient management of ER matters including grievances, disciplinary processes, and employment contract drafting and review. Ensure ongoing compliance with labour legislation, basic conditions of employment, and union-related obligations. Lead negotiations and consultations in unionised environments where required. Oversee the administration, governance, and employee experience delivery of employee benefits across the business. Lead and coordinate People and Culture Risk and Governance activities, including the development, implementation, and review of policies, risk assessments, controls, and governance frameworks. Support ad hoc People and Culture projects and initiatives as required by the business Act as a trusted subject matter expert on employment law, legal compliance, and employee advocacy. Key Skills and Experience: Postgraduate degree in Legal Studies or CIPD Level 5 qualification (essential); a further qualification in conciliation and arbitration is advantageous. 5-7 years' experience in People & Culture / Human Resources Management with a focus on People Risk and Benefits. Minimum 5 years' demonstrated Employee Relations experience at management level, covering grievances, disciplinary matters, employment contracts, and collective agreements. Experience handling negotiations and consultations in a unionised environment (advantageous). Experience operating in a multi-national environment covering at least two jurisdictions (advantageous). Strong competencies in dispute resolution, employee advocacy, legal advisory and interpretation, and legal compliance. Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge ideas constructively and build effective working relationships at all levels. High attention to detail with strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills. This is a rare opportunity to step into a high-profile, broad-ranging senior HR role within one of the island's most respected financial services employers. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16894

Our client, a well-established business based in central Douglas, is looking for a Client Services Administrator to join its small, friendly team on a full-time, office-based basis. You’ll be the first point of contact for the firm’s clients and handle their queries and requests professionally from start to finish. Listening carefully is central to the job, so you’ll need to understand what clients are really asking for and make sure nothing is missed. You’ll work closely with the rest of the team but will also be trusted to think for yourself and use your own judgement.

You’ll have at least two years of office experience, a mature and calm outlook, and excellent attention to detail. Strong IT skills are essential because you’ll move between systems with confidence and pick up new software quickly. The client wants someone who is keen to learn and grow with the business, and who takes real pride in getting things right for clients.

The salary is £28,000 to £30,000 per annum, depending on experience.

To find out more or apply in confidence, call Ambitions on 01624 614841, text or WhatsApp 07624 214841, or email your CV to info@ambitions.co.im. You can also visit www.ambitions.co.im.

Notes
OVERVIEW
We are seeking a Housing Officer to join our Housing & Property Team. The successful candidate will be passionate about delivering excellent customer service and will demonstrate openness, honesty, trustworthiness and a strong commitment to treating people fairly. You will also need to be resilient and able to remain professional under pressure, as the role may involve supporting customers who are experiencing highly emotional or challenging personal circumstances.

You should have excellent literacy skills and be a confident communicator. You must be able to demonstrate a commitment to maintaining the Council’s high standards of service and hold a full, clean and valid driving licence. If you are ready for a new challenge and share our passion for delivering outstanding customer service, including going the extra mile when required, we would welcome your application.
SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential

1.	5 GCSEs, including English and Maths.  Grade C or above or equivalent.
2.	Experience interacting with the public in person and over the telephone.
3.	Excellent customer care skills and ability to deal with customer complaints.
4.	An understanding of performance management and its relevance to the housing service.
5.	Excellent communication, analytical, written and oral skills.
6.	Ability to work as part of a Team.
7.	Ability to set priorities and manage progress of work.
8.	Self-motivated, innovative and capable of working under pressure.
9.	ICT Literate.
10.	Full valid driving licence and own vehicle (mileage allowance payable in accordance with the terms and conditions of employment).

Desirable

1.	Chartered Institute of Housing Level 3 Qualification or equivalent
2.	Experience of working in a housing service.
3.	Interviewing skills.
4.	Experience of local government.
5.	An understanding of the operations and functions of a local authority.
6.	Knowledge of the Council’s Standing Orders, Financial Regulations and the Isle of Man Government Procedures for Capital Projects (including requirements for Petitioning purposes).
7.	Political sensitivity.

To apply or find out more information, please visit our Job Train portal via the Douglas City Council’s website Job pages. For an informal chat about the role please contact Jay Chatwood, Housing & Property Operations Manager 696473 or by email JChatwood@douglas.gov.im . Alternatively, you can contact the Human Resources Section on (696455).

The closing date for the receipt of completed applications is 11:59pm, on 7th December 2026.

Miss K J Rice, Chief Executive, City Hall, Ridgeway Street, Douglas, Isle of Man, IM99 1A
Douglas City Council is committed to recruiting a diverse and highly talented workforce representative of our City and are committed to ensuring the recruitment and selection process is inclusive and accessible to all. Place and manage purchase orders with Far East suppliers, predominantly in China.
Liaise with suppliers regarding pricing, quantities, lead times, order status and delivery schedules.

Proactively review and chase outstanding and overdue orders, identifying reasons for delays and following through on required actions.

Ensure relevant import documentation is complete and accurate, supporting compliance with applicable import controls.
Produce supplier OTIF and schedule adherence reports for the Purchasing Manager.
Maintain a high standard of purchasing and supply chain data accuracy.
Support the continuous improvement of purchasing processes, systems and procedures.

Our client seeks a diligent and detail-oriented Compliance Administrator to support the compliance framework. You will assist the Head of Compliance and Directors in ensuring that the business meets its statutory, regulatory, and internal governance obligations. Key Responsibilities: Assist with customer due diligence (CDD) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) checks for new and existing clients. Conduct periodic reviews of client files to ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and up to date. Perform screening of clients, beneficial owners, and connected parties. Support the identification and escalation of suspicious activity in line with internal procedures. Help maintain compliance registers, including breaches, complaints, PEPs, sanctions, and training logs. Assist in monitoring compliance with the Isle of Man Financial Services Authority's Regulatory and AML/CFT Frameworks. Support thematic reviews, and business risk assessments. Contribute to the preparation of compliance reports for the board. Assist in drafting, updating and maintaining compliance policies and procedures. Help ensure staff are aware of regulatory changes and internal policy updates. Respond to internal queries about compliance, CDD requirements, and regulatory obligations. Assist with onboarding processes and ongoing monitoring workflows. Support the Client Services team in improving data quality within Reverto. Key Skills and Experience: Essential: Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. Good understanding of Isle of Man AML/CFT and regulatory expectations. Excellent organisational and time-management skills. Strong written and verbal communication abilities. Ability to work with confidential information with discretion and professionalism. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office. 5 GCSEs or equivalent at grade C or above. Desirable: Experience within a TCSP, fiduciary, or financial services environment. Familiarity with IOMFSA Rulebook, AML/CFT Code, and relevant legislation. Working knowledge of screening tools and Reverto. Progress toward a relevant qualification (for example, certificate in regulation, AML or Trust Estate Practitioner). 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16851

Our client seeks a permanent Head of Compliance to join their team on a part-time basis for 2 days a week. Subject to regulatory approval, and after adequate training and familiarisation, the role holder will ultimately hold the following statutory positions: Compliance Officer, under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book. Ideally, Money Laundering Reporting Officer, under the IOM AML/CFT Code 2019. You must be able to satisfy the IOM FSA on competence, time commitment, accessibility and effective oversight. An initial familiarisation period may be agreed before specific statutory positions are formally transferred. Key Responsibilities: Discharge the statutory role under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book, acting as primary point of contact with the IOM FSA. Maintain compliance monitoring programme, regulatory returns, statutory registers, policy suite and the authorisation of new SPV structures. Oversee periodic client reviews and approve higher-risk new business across the SPV book. Ideally hold the MLRO function, receive internal reports, liaise with the IOM Financial Intelligence Unit. Run group sanctions screening (OFSI, OFAC, EU, UN), customer due diligence and transaction monitoring proportionate to the group's exposure, with particular attention to maritime risk. Deliver annual AML/CFT training to employees and report to the relevant boards on financial crime risk. Maintain the compliance requirements and risk assessment suite, AML/CFT and policy suite, and report to the Board. Key Skills and Experience: Ideally minimum three years' compliance experience in regulated financial services. Working knowledge of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book and AML/CFT Code 2019. Happy to work for 2 days a week only. Recognised compliance qualification such as the ICA Diploma in Compliance, the CISI Diploma in Investment Compliance or equivalent. Based in the Isle of Man. Track record of direct FSA engagement. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16832

Our client seeks a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join their in-house team. Role Profile: This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of legal matters, work closely with the business, and play a hands-on role in shaping how legal supports a growing international company. This position is suited to a proactive and detail-oriented lawyer who is comfortable working independently, taking accountability, and driving continuous improvement in legal processes and documentation. Key responsibilities: Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including SaaS/software licensing, partnerships, and supplier contracts. Act as a key legal contact for business stakeholders, providing clear, pragmatic, and commercially focused advice. Take ownership of legal support for designated business areas. Identify and implement improvements to legal processes, workflows, and ways of working. Develop and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and internal guidance. Collaborate with a multi-jurisdictional legal team. Manage external counsel and support disputes where required. Monitor relevant legal and regulatory developments in the gaming and technology sectors. Support strategic business initiatives, including new product development. Key Skills & Experience: 4-6 years PQE (post qualification experience) as a solicitor, advocate or equivalent required - this is a guideline so if you feel that you are suitable, please still apply. Strong grounding in commercial and contract law. Experience in the gaming industry/software development industry is advantageous but not essential. Ability to work independently, take ownership, and manage priorities. Experience improving legal processes, templates, or ways of working is highly desirable. Excellent drafting, negotiation, and communication skills. Ability to provide practical, business-focused advice in a clear and concise manner. Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively across different jurisdictions and cultures. A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and interest in the gaming/technology space. Experience working with legal technology tools (e.g. CLM systems, document automation) is advantageous. Interest in leveraging AI and legal technology to improve legal service delivery and efficiency is desirable. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16917

Preparing screens for printing.
Mixing inks and matching colours.
Screen printing a wide range of garments to a high standard.
Maintaining a clean, organised and efficient working environment.
Working closely with the team to ensure orders are completed accurately and on time.
 
What we're looking for:

 
Previous experience in screen printing would be an advantage, but it's not essential, as full training will be provided. 

More importantly, we're looking for someone with a positive attitude, a strong work ethic and a willingness to learn and develop their skills. 

Attention to detail is essential, along with the ability to work both independently and as part of a close-knit team. 

A clean driving licence would also be beneficial. 

Work Permit Requirement: Applicants must already hold a full, valid Isle of Man work permit or have unrestricted permission to work on the Island. 

Hours, holiday entitlement, and rates of pay will be discussed with successful applicants. 

If you're reliable, enthusiastic, and looking for an opportunity to learn a skilled trade within a friendly, established business, we'd love to hear from you!

Notes
Feel Connected to the future at Sure by joining as a Head of Enterprise Cloud & Managed Services, working 37.5 hours per week.

To drive the role forward, the individual will be responsible for the performance of the Channel Islands and Isle of Man technical solutions, support and service implementation functions delivered to Enterprise customers. This is key role within the senior management team. This position requires a leader with a strong background in Enterprise / B2B operations, cloud technologies, connectivity solutions, and managed services, capable of both working at a short-term and tactical levels as well as holding a compass and inspiring the teams to capture the more mid-term and strategic opportunities ahead, in particular cloud and AI.

Sure are looking for candidates who would like to feel connected to future technologies and change, global opportunities, personal development, and working in a great team. Passionate about their people and communities, the ideal individual would hold the following skills:

Significant experience of managing and leading large teams coming from diverse technical backgrounds (Fixed, Mobile, Voice, Data/IP, IOT, Security);
Technical expertise in designing and operating cloud-native platforms, including compution, storage, networking, virtualization and containerization, as well as hyperscalers (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Proven technical expertise across most telecom domains: Fixed (fibre), Mobile (4G), Voice (TDM or/and IP based), Data/IP (site connectivity and key protocols), IOT (M2M, NB-IOT, LTE-M…), security protocols and standards.
Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills with a consultative approach; able to work with stakeholders at all levels both internal and external to the Sure business.
We are proud of the “way we do things” at Sure; We work together as One Team, We strive for Customer Satisfaction, We are Reliable, We have a Passion for Technology & Learning and We are Community & Sustainability Focused, and individuals applying will “feel connected” to our Company values.

You will be joining a Company that is committed to developing highly engaged professional employees, offering a competitive remuneration package, as well as great staff benefits:

Free Ultrafast Broadband,
Free Unlimited Max mobile contract,
Generous bonus scheme,
Healthcare
Company pension
Parking/Bicycle facilities 
To apply, please send CVs to recruitment@sure.com.

Notes
We’re looking for experienced compliance professionals to join our Risk, Legal & Compliance team in the Isle of Man and are recruiting for two senior regulatory compliance specialists. This is a senior, hands-on role offering the opportunity to work across a broad range of regulatory matters, from regulatory change and compliance frameworks to Board reporting, strategic projects and engagement with regulators. You’ll play an important part in helping IFGL identify and manage regulatory risk while ensuring our approach remains proportionate, practical and commercially aware.

What you’ll be doing:
Developing and continuously improving IFGL’s compliance framework.
Monitoring regulatory developments and helping the business understand and implement regulatory change.
Managing day-to-day regulatory relationships, including regulatory submissions, inspections, investigations and controlled function applications.
Providing clear, insightful reporting to Boards and senior management on compliance monitoring, breaches, emerging risks and regulatory developments.
Acting as a compliance subject matter expert on key strategic projects.
Developing and delivering targeted compliance training and awareness.
Coaching and supporting colleagues across Compliance and the wider Risk, Legal & Compliance function. 

What we’re looking for:
A relevant professional qualification in compliance or risk management, or equivalent practical experience.
Senior-level compliance experience within financial services, ideally with exposure to multiple jurisdictions.
Experience of compliance monitoring/assurance and implementing regulatory change.
A strong understanding of regulatory and financial crime risk, including AML/CFT frameworks.
Excellent analytical skills and the ability to turn complex regulatory issues into clear, pragmatic solutions.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Sound professional judgement and the ability to work autonomously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  
An ICA Diploma or equivalent, and experience contributing compliance expertise to strategic projects would be advantageous.

Why this role?

This is an opportunity to take on a broad and influential compliance role, working with Executive Management, Boards and teams across IFGL, as well as external regulators and industry bodies. You’ll have the scope to influence how regulatory requirements are translated into practical business solutions and help strengthen compliance capability across the organisation.

If you, or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward your current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com 

We encourage and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds because we embrace diversity and inclusivity within our business.

The closing date for this vacancy will be 2nd December 2026.

Our client seeks a Junior Company & Trust Administrator to join their team. Role: To provide administrative support in the management of client trusts, companies and other fiduciary structures, while undertaking structured on-the-job training and developing knowledge, skills and practical experience in trust and company administration. Working under the guidance and supervision of senior team members, the role is designed as an entry-level position that provides a foundation for a career in fiduciary services. Reporting directly to the Senior Manager, the Junior Trust and Company Administrator will assist with the administration of client entities, including trusts and companies, while gaining practical experience within a professional fiduciary environment. Working closely with senior team members, the role supports the maintenance of client records, preparation of documentation, completion of administrative processes and delivery of client service, ensuring activities are undertaken accurately and in accordance with regulatory requirements, internal procedures and service standards. Key Skills and Experience: GCSEs (or equivalent) including English and Mathematics. A Levels or equivalent qualifications preferred but not essential. Willingness to undertake relevant professional development and fiduciary qualifications. Good general office administration knowledge. Competent in Microsoft Office applications. Understanding of the importance of confidentiality and accuracy. Willingness to develop knowledge of trust and company administration and relevant regulatory requirements. Previous office administration experience desirable. Experience within the fiduciary, financial services or professional services sector would be advantageous but is not essential. Willingness to learn. Good attention to detail. Organised and methodical approach. Ability to follow procedures and instructions. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to prioritise workload and meet deadlines. Team player. 
 For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number:  16954

Are you a commercially minded Business Analyst who thrives on turning ideas into clear requirements and measurable business value? We have an exciting opportunity to join our Group Change Department and play a key role in shaping and delivering change across the business. You will work with project managers, delivery teams, stakeholders and third-party partners to define outcomes, prioritise value and support successful delivery from discovery through to implementation.

The main responsibilities for the role holder will include:

Shaping compelling business cases and clear problem statements that focus delivery on measurable business value and customer outcomes.
Mapping as-is and to-be processes, identifying gaps, dependencies, risks and opportunities for operational improvement.
Eliciting, analysing and documenting clear business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and supporting artefacts for agile and hybrid delivery teams.
Conducting data analysis to uncover opportunities and inform decisions.
Completing gap analysis, impact assessments and options analysis to support informed decision-making and delivery planning.
Providing business analysis support across software development, testing, data migration, upgrades, release readiness and implementation activity.
Collaborating closely with business users, project managers, IT teams, third parties and outsource providers to maintain alignment and delivery momentum.
Supporting sprint refinement, backlog prioritisation, UAT planning, test preparation and business validation to ensure solutions are ready for adoption.
Helping teams embed change by supporting communication, training, adoption planning and continuous improvement.
Mentoring junior members of the team and contributing to best practice within the change team.

Notes
The Senior Advisor, Marketing & Commercial Strategy advises ACE Hollreiser's clients in online gaming and fintech on how to plan their marketing, shape their commercial strategy and develop their digital business. It is an advisory role, not a sales role: the Senior Advisor works with client leadership teams on marketing plans, growth and market-entry strategy, and the operating models that deliver them, and complements ACE's reputation, branding, PR and corporate affairs services.
Key responsibilities:
Marketing planning: Assess a client's brand, audience, channels and marketing performance, and build annual and multi-market marketing plans with clear objectives, budgets and measures of success. Advise on how to split marketing budgets between brand and performance channels, and on acquisition, CRM and retention strategy for regulated consumer products. Review clients' marketing technology and analytics set-ups, and recommend how to measure return on investment.
Commercial strategy advisory: Assess a client's objectives, markets, competitors and operating model; identify problems in their commercial strategy, organisation and procedures; and formulate recommendations and help implement them. Advise on pricing, product and promotion strategy, margins and unit economics, and the trade-off between growth and profitability. Advise on how licensing, advertising and consumer-protection rules in each market should shape marketing and commercial decisions.
Digital business development advisory: Advise on market entry, product launches, partnerships and expansion across several jurisdictions, including the commercial case and a phased roadmap. Help clients design operating models and delivery roadmaps that align their commercial, marketing, product and technology teams. Run workshops and present research findings and recommendations to boards and senior executives.
Working at ACE: Contribute sector expertise to ACE's proposals and client discussions, and work with ACE's brand, content and communications specialists on joint engagements. The role carries no personal sales target. Mentor consultants and account managers working on engagements.
Skills, experience and qualifications
Essential: Min 10 years in senior marketing, commercial or strategy roles in regulated online gaming or fintech. Experience building marketing plans and commercial strategies and managing significant marketing budgets and agencies. Strong analytical skills: turn performance data on acquisition, retention and margin into clear recommendations. Experience advising senior stakeholders and presenting recommendations clearly in writing and in person. Understanding of how licensing and advertising regulation shapes marketing and commercial decisions. Master degree in business, marketing or a related field. Fluent business English.
Desirable: Second European language. Market entry, launch and platform migration in Central/Eastern Europe. Professional gaming/fintech  network.

For more details and to apply contact eric@acehollreiser.com

Notes
An opportunity has arisen for a Technical Services Wealth Planner to join IFGL within the Technical Services team.  Based in Douglas, the successful candidate will provide technical support and guidance across IFGL businesses, Sales Teams, advisers and other stakeholders on financial planning, taxation, trusts, international tax reporting and regulatory matters.  This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced technical professional to contribute to business growth, adviser engagement and customer retention initiatives while helping to ensure IFGL’s technical propositions remain accurate, compliant and commercially relevant.

Responsibilities:
Provide timely, accurate and practical technical support on financial planning, taxation, trust planning, customer tax reporting and regulatory matters to colleagues, advisers and other stakeholders. 
Support Sales Teams and advisers by identifying planning opportunities, responding to technical enquiries and assisting with presentations, meetings and business development initiatives. 
Develop and deliver technical training, educational content, webinars, briefings and guidance materials for colleagues, advisers and customers. 
Monitor relevant tax, trust and regulatory developments, assessing their impact on IFGL businesses, products and customers, and communicating key updates to stakeholders. 
Work closely with teams across Sales, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Marketing and Product to ensure technical information remains accurate, current and aligned with legislative and regulatory requirements. 
Support the management of technical and regulatory risks by applying sound judgement, maintaining high standards of accuracy and escalating concerns where appropriate.

Skills and Experience:
Strong technical knowledge of financial planning, taxation, trusts and offshore life assurance products, with the ability to interpret and communicate complex information clearly and practically. 
Experience working within financial services, financial planning, taxation, compliance, legal or a related technical environment. 
Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across business functions, advisers and external partners. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with sound professional judgement and a high level of attention to detail. 
Experience delivering technical training, educational content or adviser-facing communications would be advantageous. 
The ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines while maintaining a high standard of quality and accuracy. 
Relevant financial planning, taxation, trust, compliance or financial services qualifications, or equivalent industry experience. Experience working across multiple jurisdictions would be beneficial.

If you, or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward your current CV to careers@ifg-ltd.com

Notes
Build your career in New Homes Sales with Dandara!

Are you a natural people person who loves delivering great customer service? Looking for an exciting career opportunity where your personality, enthusiasm and ambition matter just as much as your experience?

At Dandara, we don't just build houses – we create beautiful homes and communities where people love to live.

We're looking for a friendly, motivated and customer-focused New Homes Sales Consultant to join our Isle of Man team, helping customers find their perfect home.

You don't need previous experience in new homes sales to join us. We're keen to hear from people with backgrounds in retail, hospitality, customer service, estate agency or other sales environments who are looking to take their next career step. This role will be based at our Douglas Sales Office.

If you're confident, approachable, organised and eager to learn, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll be doing

As a New Homes Sales Consultant, you'll be the welcoming face of Dandara, helping customers through one of the most exciting and important purchases they'll ever make.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
Making a great first impression – welcoming prospective buyers to our developments and show homes, creating a friendly and professional experience.
Helping customers find their dream home – understanding what they're looking for, showcasing our properties and explaining the features and benefits of each home.

Building lasting relationships – supporting customers throughout their homebuying journey, from their initial enquiry through to receiving their keys.
Supporting the sales process – responding to enquiries, arranging viewings, following up with potential purchasers and helping secure reservations.
Personalising the experience – helping customers explore optional extras and upgrades to make their new home their own.
Working together – liaising with colleagues, mortgage advisers and legal representatives to ensure sales progress smoothly.
Keeping things organised – maintaining accurate customer records, updating our sales system and ensuring our show homes and sales areas always look their best.
Creating memorable moments – helping with home demonstrations and preparing for the exciting day customers collect their keys.
Learning about the local market – developing your understanding of our Isle of Man developments, available properties and the wider housing market.

What we're looking for
We're looking for someone with the right attitude, personality and potential. Previous property sales experience would be welcome, but it's certainly not essential.
Ideally, you'll have:
Experience in a customer-facing role, whether that's retail, hospitality, customer service, sales or a similar environment.
A full driving licence.
Flexibility to work weekends as part of your normal working week.

Please apply here to this role - https://careers.dandara.com/jobs/8575717-new-homes-sales-consultant

We're looking for an organised, creative and enthusiastic Marketing & Communications Executive to join our busy Group Marketing team.

Based at our Isle of Man head office, you'll work alongside our in-house marketing and design team, supporting a wide variety of marketing activities across our property developments and business operations in the UK, Isle of Man and Jersey. This is a varied role, ideal for someone with a broad marketing background who enjoys managing multiple projects, creating engaging content and seeing ideas through to delivery. At this stage we will only be considering applications from Isle of Man based applicants who do not require an employment visa.

About the role

Working closely with our design studio and regional marketing teams, your responsibilities will include:

Supporting the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
Coordinating creative briefs and managing projects through our in-house design studio.
Writing and adapting copy for advertising, marketing collateral and communications.
Assisting with the production and distribution of marketing and promotional materials.
Coordinating promotional content for resident events across our UK build to rent developments.
Supporting digital marketing campaigns through the coordination of creative assets, and assisting with the creation and scheduling of organic social media content.
Liaising with internal teams and external suppliers to ensure projects are delivered on time.
Providing general marketing and administrative support to the wider team.

About you
We're looking for someone who is proactive, adaptable and highly organised, with excellent communication skills and a genuine enthusiasm for marketing.
You'll ideally have:

At least two years' experience in a marketing or communications role, either in-house or agency side.
Excellent copywriting skills and a strong eye for detail.
Experience coordinating marketing projects and working with creative teams.
The ability to manage multiple priorities and work to deadlines.
Confidence communicating with colleagues, stakeholders and external suppliers.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
A positive, flexible approach and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Experience managing organic social media content for business accounts, particularly Facebook and Instagram, would be an advantage. Familiarity with Canva or social media scheduling platforms would also be beneficial, although not essential. 

Please apply for this role here as this is the only we we will receive applications for this role - https://careers.dandara.com/jobs/8671642-marketing-and-communications-executive

Notes
As a Commercial Plumber, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, testing and repair of plumbing systems within commercial buildings, including offices, schools, hospitals, and industrial facilities. The ideal candidate will have experience working with large-scale plumbing systems, ensuring compliance with Regulations such as Health and Safety and Approved Codes of Practice while delivering high-quality workmanship.

Key Responsibilities
1. Installation Work
Install and commission new plumbing systems, including water distribution, heating, sanitary ware, pipework, drainage, and plantroom equipment.
Interpret and work from technical drawings, specifications, and job instructions.
Ensure compliance with BS EN standards, the Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations, and manufacturer requirements.

2. Maintenance & Repairs
Perform reactive and planned preventative maintenance (PPM) on plumbing and/or gas systems including:
Pipework and valves
Booster sets and hot water systems
Pressurisation units
Thermostatic mixing valves (TMVs)
Diagnose and rectify faults efficiently to minimise downtime and disruption.
Inspect, test and service equipment in line with industry standards.

3. Compliance & Certification
Ensure compliance with relevant legislation including:
UK: Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999, Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998 (if applicable), Building Regulations Part G.
Isle of Man: Building Regulations 2014 and associated technical standards, including plumbing, water heating and drainage.
Complete documentation such as commissioning records, service reports, and compliance certificates.
Work in accordance with Legionella prevention guidance (e.g. L8/HSG274 and Isle of Man equivalents).
Gas Safe registration and Core gas qualification is desireable.

For more details and to apply contact careers@ifg.im or 01624603660.

At Westmoreland Road Spar, we pride ourselves on being the friendly face of our local community. We are looking for a reliable, energetic, and customer-focused individual to join our dedicated team as a Shop Assistant.

As a Shop Assistant, you will be the heart of our store, ensuring our customers receive a warm welcome and excellent service. Your daily duties will involve operating the till accurately, handling cash and card transactions, stocking shelves, rotating stock, and maintaining high standards of store cleanliness and presentation. You will also assist customers with queries and uphold all health, safety, and licensing regulations.

We believe in investing in our team. Beyond your daily shop duties, you will receive structured training to become a Responsible Person for the store. This is a fantastic opportunity to develop leadership skills, take on extra responsibility, and grow within the business.

We are looking for someone with a flexible schedule who can work regular evening and weekend shifts. You should have a friendly, approachable attitude and be passionate about delivering great service. Punctuality, honesty, and the ability to work well independently as well as part of a team are essential. Previous retail experience is preferred, but not essential, as full training will be provided for the right candidate who demonstrates a strong work ethic and enthusiasm.

In return, we offer comprehensive, hands-on training from day one, opportunities for career progression and leadership development, a competitive pay rate, staff discounts, and a supportive, friendly working environment.

If you are ready for a new challenge and want to join a great local team, we would love to hear from you. Please send your CV along with a short note detailing your availability to westmorelandroad@spar.co.im

About the Role
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Quality Control Analyst to join our Quality Control team in the Isle of Man. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the testing and release of specialist products while supporting quality standards, laboratory operations and continuous improvement initiatives. This role offers exposure to a variety of analytical techniques and opportunities to develop within a regulated laboratory environment.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct testing of raw materials, intermediates and finished products, maintain laboratory records, perform environmental monitoring activities, support equipment maintenance and calibration, assist with investigations, train colleagues and contribute to continuous improvement activities.
About You
A degree in a scientific discipline is desirable, together with strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work independently. Previous laboratory experience within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or chemical manufacturing environment would be advantageous.
Working Environment
Laboratory-based role involving analytical testing, the use of laboratory equipment and adherence to quality and safety procedures. The role may require occasional flexibility to support operational requirements.
Why Join Us?
Opportunity to work within a quality-focused environment, gain experience across a range of analytical techniques and products, and develop your skills through ongoing training and professional development.

We are looking to recruit one (1) Knitwear Product Developer & Knitting Coordinator to join our Production Department.

The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating knitwear product development and knitting operations, acting as the key link between Product Development, Knitting Programming and Production. The role involves planning and scheduling knitting activities to ensure production runs efficiently and meets customer requirements, quality standards and delivery deadlines.

The candidate will also support new product development, optimise knitting operations and contribute to continuous improvement within the department.

Key Requirements includes; 2–5 years of experience in the knitwear industry, Experience in knitwear product development and knitting coordination, Strong organisational, planning and communication skills, Ability to liaise effectively between product development and production teams, Knowledge of knitting processes and production planning, Chinese language proficiency is mandatory.
